title: IT Recruiter
description:
**About Corvi Technologies**
Corvi Technologies is a growing technology services company working closely with startups, product companies, and fast-scaling technology organizations. We specialize in delivering high‑quality technical talent across modern engineering and digital stacks.
  
  
We are looking for a strong, hands‑on IT Recruiter who comes strictly from an IT staffing / recruitment consultancy background and has proven experience hiring for startup and product‑based companies.
  
  
Note: This position is not suitable for candidates with only corporate HR or internal talent acquisition experience.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As an IT Recruiter at Corvi Technologies, you will handle end‑to‑end technical recruitment for startup and product clients. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, closing positions, and ensuring timely onboarding. This role requires strong sourcing skills, technical hiring exposure, urgency, and ownership.
  
  
**Mandatory Criteria (Please Read Carefully)**

* 2 to 5 years of experience strictly from an IT recruitment consultancy or staffing firm
* Hands‑on experience hiring for startup and/or product‑based companies
* Experience working on direct client requirements
* Corporate HR / internal TA profiles will not be considered

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete IT recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding
* Handle multiple technical requirements simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment
* Source candidates using LinkedIn, Naukri, ATS, job portals, referrals, and advanced Boolean searches
* Conduct detailed screening covering technical skills, communication, stability, and role fit
* Coordinate interviews, gather feedback, and drive fast closures
* Maintain strong candidate pipelines and market intelligence
* Meet weekly and monthly hiring targets with consistent quality
* Build long‑term relationships with active and passive candidates

**Technical Hiring Exposure Required**
Candidates should have experience recruiting for roles such as:
  
  

* Software Engineers (Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Frontend, Full Stack)
* Product Engineers
* Cloud, DevOps, and SRE professionals
* Data Engineers and Data Scientists
* QA, Automation, and Mobile Developers
* Other modern technology roles as required

**Required Skills And Attributes**

* Strong understanding of technical roles, stacks, and hiring terminology
* Excellent sourcing and Boolean search skills
* Target‑driven and closure‑oriented mindset
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities
* Comfortable working in high‑pressure, startup‑style recruitment environments
* High ownership, accountability, and self‑motivation

**What We Offer**

* Fully remote opportunity within India
* Competitive compensation with performance‑based incentives
* Exposure to startup and product‑based clients
* Fast‑paced, high‑learning work environment
* Quick decision‑making and visible impact

title: Senior IT Recruitment
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Arohana Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd is seeking a Senior IT Recruiter to lead and manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical roles across multiple domains. The ideal candidate will have in-depth knowledge of IT recruitment, including contract staffing and niche technology hiring. You will partner closely with hiring managers and leadership teams to develop strategies for attracting, evaluating, and onboarding top-tier IT professionals.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Recruitment: Manage the complete recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding for permanent and contract roles.
* Talent Sourcing: Identify and engage high-quality IT talent through multiple sourcing channels such as job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and professional networks.
* Team Mentorship: Guide and support junior recruiters, helping them improve sourcing, screening, and negotiation skills.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with hiring managers and business heads to understand workforce needs, define role requirements, and design customized recruitment plans.
* Interview Management: Conduct initial screenings, schedule technical and HR rounds, and ensure an efficient interview process.
* Offer Negotiation & Closure: Manage salary discussions, counteroffers, and ensure smooth offer rollouts and onboarding.
* Market Insights: Stay updated with the latest tech trends, salary benchmarks, and talent availability across the IT landscape.
* Reporting: Maintain recruitment dashboards and analytics to track performance and optimize hiring strategies.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, IT, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 3 years in IT Staffing (contract staffing).
* Knowledge: Strong understanding of software development roles, cloud technologies, and other emerging IT skill sets.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), job portals, and sourcing tools.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.

**Preferred**

* Experience in recruiting for startups or IT consulting firms.
* Exposure to Fintech, E-commerce, HealthTech, and Gen AI domains.
* Experience in team handling or leadership roles.
* Knowledge of diversity and inclusion best practices in recruitment.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Competitive Salary & Incentives: Attractive incentive structure, rewards, and recognition.
* Growth Opportunities: Fast-track career advancement and exposure to senior-level recruitment strategy.
* Dynamic Work Environment: Collaborative, performance-driven culture with flexibility and innovation.
* Learning & Development: Access to training programs, industry certifications, and skill development initiatives.
* Health & Term life Insurance

title: Talent Acquisition Team Lead
description:
Vedantu is looking for a proactive, target-driven, and hands-on
**Talent Acquisition Team Lead**
to drive end-to-end recruitment while managing and supporting the recruitment team.

This role is ideal for a recruitment professional who enjoys working on live hiring requirements, closing positions independently, managing stakeholders, and driving team performance. The candidate will work closely with business leaders and hiring managers to understand hiring needs, make informed hiring recommendations, and ensure timely closures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **End-to-End Hiring:**
  Independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering and sourcing to offer rollout and candidate joining.
* **Hands-on Recruitment:**
  Source and screen candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, job portals, and other channels.
* **Team Handling:**
  Guide team members, allocate hiring requirements, monitor productivity, and drive individual and team hiring targets.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Lead hiring discussions with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand role requirements, salary budgets, and hiring priorities.
* **Hiring Decisions:**
  Assess candidate suitability, share hiring recommendations, and collaborate with stakeholders on selection decisions.
* **Interview Coordination:**
  Manage interview scheduling, feedback collection, candidate follow-ups, and interview pipeline movement.
* **Offer Management:**
  Handle salary negotiations, offer closures, joining follow-ups, and candidate dropouts.
* **Recruitment Reporting:**
  Track open positions, closures, turnaround time, offer-to-joining conversions, and team performance.
* **Candidate Experience:**
  Ensure timely communication and a professional candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.
* Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment and independent position closures.
* Experience using Naukri, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to manage individual hiring targets while guiding a recruitment team.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Experience in EdTech or high-volume hiring will be an added advantage.

**Why Join Vedantu?**

* Be part of a growing EdTech organization.
* Work on diverse hiring requirements across business functions.
* Take ownership of recruitment delivery, stakeholder relationships, and team performance.
* Develop your leadership and talent acquisition capabilities.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Palasa is a botanical wares studio founded in 2016 and based in Bangalore, dedicated to transforming homes, offices, and retail spaces through thoughtfully designed planters. The studio focuses on bringing vibrance and wellbeing into urban environments by integrating greenery into both indoor and outdoor spaces. Palasa’s products highlight the seamless connection between nature, design, and everyday life. Over time, the team’s initial idea of using plants and design to enhance spaces has evolved into a strong commitment to improving the overall wellbeing of individuals and organizations through curated plant and planter solutions.

**Role Description**
The Recruitment Specialist role at Palasa is a full-time, on-site position based in Bangalore. This role is responsible for managing end-to-end hiring activities, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, and coordinating interviews for various roles within the studio and operational teams. The Recruitment Specialist will conduct structured interviews, collaborate with hiring managers to define role requirements, and ensure a positive and inclusive candidate experience. Daily responsibilities include maintaining recruitment pipelines, updating applicant tracking systems, supporting onboarding and training efforts, and contributing to employer branding initiatives that reflect Palasa’s values and culture.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Recruiting and Hiring skills, with experience managing full-cycle recruitment.
* Candidates should possess effective Interviewing skills and the ability to assess role fit objectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication with diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Training and onboarding skills to support new team members’ integration and success.
* Relevant experience in HR, talent acquisition, or recruitment coordination is beneficial.
* Knowledge of applicant tracking systems, basic HR processes, and hiring best practices is an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively on-site, prioritize multiple roles, and meet hiring timelines is required.
* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Sourcing and Screening**

* Source relevant candidates for assigned technical and non-technical internship and full-time positions using LinkedIn Hiring and other relevant sourcing channels.
* Screen profiles against job requirements and shortlist candidates who meet the role's technical, functional, and experience criteria.
* Conduct initial candidate calls to assess fitment, communication, interest, availability, and compensation expectations, wherever applicable.
* Clearly communicate Convin's business, the role, responsibilities, and recruitment process to prospective candidates.

**2. Interview Scheduling and Coordination**

* Schedule candidate interviews with internal stakeholders using Keka ATS and ensure all interview details are communicated accurately.
* Meet daily interview scheduling targets consistently.
* Proactively coordinate with candidates and interviewers to ensure interviews happen as scheduled and participants join on time.
* Follow up on interview confirmations, rescheduling, cancellations, and no-shows to minimize delays in the hiring process.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

**3. Recruitment Operations and ATS Management**

* Use Keka ATS daily to manage candidate pipelines, schedule interviews, track hiring progress, and maintain accurate recruitment records.
* Ensure interview feedback is submitted by interviewers on Keka ATS after every interview.
* Follow up with hiring managers and interviewers for pending feedback and hiring decisions.
* Keep candidate statuses, interview stages, and recruitment trackers updated and accurate.
* Ensure adherence to the defined recruitment process and timely closure of action items.

**4. Target Achievement and Hiring Execution**

* Work towards defined monthly hiring and onboarding targets and daily interview scheduling targets.
* Track recruitment progress against assigned targets and proactively address bottlenecks that may affect hiring outcomes.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements, priorities, and candidate evaluation criteria.
* Drive candidates through the recruitment funnel, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination, selection, offer rollout, and onboarding.
* Take ownership of assigned positions and ensure recruitment activities are completed within agreed timelines.

**5. Stakeholder and Candidate Management**

* Build effective working relationships with hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates.
* Communicate with clarity, confidence, and professionalism while handling recruitment-related discussions and follow-ups.
* Handle competing priorities, last-minute changes, and recruitment challenges with a solution-oriented approach.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience through timely updates, professional communication, and consistent follow-through.

**Must-Haves**

* Completed a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or currently pursuing the final semester of an engineering degree.
* At least 6 months of hands-on Talent Acquisition internship experience.
* Practical experience using LinkedIn Hiring/LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Experience hiring for both internship and full-time positions.
* Exposure to both technical and non-technical recruitment.
* Prior experience managing at least 3–4 open positions simultaneously.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup or similarly high-ownership environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with clarity of thought and a structured approach to communication.
* Confidence in speaking with candidates, explaining roles, assessing initial fitment, and managing recruitment-related calls.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, time-management, and organizational skills.
* A target-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability and ownership.
* Available to join immediately and commit to the full 3-month internship duration.
* Willingness to work full-time from Convin's Bengaluru office, five days a week.

**Good-to-Haves**

* Experience recruiting for engineering, software development, AI/ML, data, product, or other technology roles.
* Experience hiring interns through campus recruitment, college networks, job portals, or LinkedIn.
* Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as sourcing-to-screening conversion, interview scheduling, interview attendance, offer acceptance, and joining ratios.
* Experience working with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to understand role requirements and close positions.
* Experience managing candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
* Ability to identify process gaps, improve recruitment coordination, and suggest ways to improve hiring turnaround time.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize multiple requirements without compromising candidate experience.

**What You Will Gain**

* Hands-on experience managing recruitment for technical and non-technical roles in a growing AI startup.
* Exposure to end-to-end Talent Acquisition, from sourcing and screening to selection, offer coordination, and onboarding.
* Opportunities to work directly with the HR Manager and internal hiring stakeholders.
* Practical experience using LinkedIn Hiring and Keka ATS while working with measurable recruitment targets.
* The opportunity to build strong stakeholder-management, communication, and execution skills.

**Selection Process**

* **Round 1 – HR Fitment Check:**
  Discussion with the HR Manager to assess prior experience, communication, role understanding, and overall fitment.
* **Round 2 – IQ Assessment:**
  Assessment of logical reasoning and problem-solving ability.
* **Round 3 – Case Study / On-the-Spot Assignment:**
  A practical recruitment assignment with the HR Manager to evaluate sourcing, screening, prioritization, communication, and execution skills.
* **Final Decision and Offer:**
  Selected candidates will receive an offer following the final evaluation.

**Company Description**
AawazAI is a voice-first financial operating system designed for India’s micro, small, and medium businesses, including millions of GST-registered enterprises. Business owners can speak to Aawaz in Hindi, Hinglish, or English to record sales, purchases, payments, expenses, and GST queries, while the platform manages the underlying bookkeeping and compliance.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=biz.aawaz.app&pli=1

Aawaz handles GST compliance, GSTR 2B reconciliation, GSTR 1 and GSTR 3B filing, deadline alerts, and financial reports with no accounting expertise required from users. Which is deployed at https://ca.aawazai.com/workspace Built for shop owners, distributors, contractors, and small businesses across India, AawazAI reflects how micro-entrepreneurs actually run their businesses.

The product is developed in Bengaluru by GenCrafter Technologies Private Limited.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru for an Entry Level CA and Accountant at AawazAI. Person will be validating the software developed by GenCrafter for the correctness.

* Solid foundation in accounting principles, including journal entries, ledgers, trial balance, and preparation of basic financial statements.
* Knowledge of Indian GST regulations, GST returns (GSTR 1, GSTR 3B, GSTR 2B), and compliance timelines.

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and accuracy in handling numerical data.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain financial and GST concepts clearly.

* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Educational background such as Chartered Accountant (CA) or semi-qualified CA, B.Com, M.Com, or equivalent degree in finance or accounting.
* Interest in technology-led solutions for small businesses and willingness to engage directly with micro-entrepreneurs.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Bengaluru / Remote | 3–10 years

**About Target HR**

Target HR is a talent search firm for high-growth product companies from Seed to Series D. We help them hire across Product, Technology, Leadership, GTM, Sales and Marketing.

We work directly with Founders, CXOs, HR Leaders and Business Heads. Our job isn't to forward

profiles. We help clients understand the talent market, define who they actually need, and build their teams.

**The role**

As an Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of client relationships and become the go-to person for their hiring. The role combines client management, problem solving, recruitment and business growth.

**What you'll do**

• Partner with Founders, CXOs, HR Leaders and Hiring Managers on their most important hires.

• Understand the business behind each requirement, not just the JD.

• Define the right talent profile, target companies and search approach.

• Drive searches with our Recruiter's and Sourcer's, and keep the funnel moving.

• Manage interviews, feedback, offers and closures.

• Use market data, such as compensation, talent availability and candidate behaviour, to shape client decisions.

**Growing your accounts**

Business development here comes from the work itself, not cold calling. As you run searches, you'll build trust with founders and leaders. That trust leads to new mandates within your accounts and introductions to new companies. You'll own the growth of your portfolio.

**Why this role is interesting**

No two months look the same. You might run a Product leadership search for a Series C fintech, then help a B2B SaaS company build its GTM team, then work with a founder on their first leadership hires.

Over time, you'll learn how businesses are built, how teams are structured, and how talent decisions shape a company's trajectory. It's an education in startups as much as in recruitment.

**Who we're looking for**

• 3–10 years in recruitment, executive search, talent solutions, B2B sales, consulting or account

management.• You're genuinely curious about startups and how businesses work.

• You're comfortable with numbers and use data to make a case.

• You can own a client relationship end to end without close supervision.

• You want to grow into a larger business role, not stay in a desk role.

**Where this can go**

Start by owning a set of accounts. Grow them, build your own portfolio and revenue, and eventually your own team.

→
**Vertical / P&L; Owner**

* Workforce planning and recruitment: Work with department heads to identify staffing needs, prepare role profiles and hiring plans, manage sourcing and interviews, and secure approvals for selection and offers. Track hiring progress and joining readiness.
* Onboarding and employee lifecycle: Own joining documentation, company and brand orientation, policy explanation, department training coordination, and probation reviews. Maintain the HR lifecycle tracker with milestone owners, dates, subtask status, evidence, and pending support.
* Policies and company culture: Develop and maintain policies for management approval. Explain attendance, leave, WFH, payroll, travel, reimbursement, conduct, and confidentiality requirements. Obtain employee acknowledgements and promote accountability, respectful behaviour, and collaboration.
* Attendance and payroll coordination: Own attendance and leave accuracy, approval follow-ups, and payroll input closure. Coordinate with Finance on payroll processing, employee changes, reimbursements, and queries; verify inputs and resolve discrepancies before the agreed cut-off.
* Employee relations and performance: Handle employee concerns fairly and confidentially, guide managers on documented feedback and review practices, and coordinate performance reviews, development plans, and retention actions. Escalate matters requiring management decisions.
* Training and manager support: Identify training needs with department heads, organize induction and role-specific training, and maintain completion records. Support managers in communicating responsibilities, work instructions, and performance expectations.
* Confidential records and folder governance: Finalize the HR folder structure and data migration. Maintain payroll and employee documents in restricted folders, with shortcuts in the main HR folder and approval-based access requests. Keep records current and manage access with authorized owners.
* Assets, handover, and exits: Coordinate asset issue and return with Admin/IT and relevant owners. Ensure asset-register entries and signed handover records are complete. Manage exit documentation, knowledge transfer, clearance, and final-settlement inputs with Finance.
* Compliance and management reporting: Coordinate applicable employment and payroll compliance with Finance and qualified advisers. Maintain relevant records, monitor pending actions, and submit concise HR updates, risks, escalations, and support requirements to management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of HR experience, including independent ownership of HR operations and coordination with leadership and department heads.
* Hands-on experience in recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, attendance, payroll coordination, performance reviews, and policy implementation.
* Experience in a growing consumer-brand, distribution, retail, e-commerce, or similar business is preferred.
* Working knowledge of relevant employment and payroll requirements, with the ability to coordinate specialist support when needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and practical problem-solving.
* Sound judgement, discretion, and consistent handling of confidential employee information.
* Ability to establish clear processes, maintain accurate records, and close actions on time.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and HR systems; ability to manage trackers, reports, and folder permissions.
* Ability to handle sensitive conversations, support managers, and encourage an owner-driven working culture.

**Location & Work Mode**

The role is based in Bangalore and is an onsite position.

title: Manager - People & Culture
description:
**About AiDASH**
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
  
  
The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.
  
  
Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
  
  
**The Role**
We don't believe P&C creates impact by starting with policies, processes, or frameworks, but by
**understanding the business and the people deeply enough to influence real decisions.**
In this role, you won't be expected to jump in and 'fix' things on day one. Instead, you'll be expected to
**listen, observe, learn, and build context**
- about the vision, business, the teams, and the individuals who make the work happen.
  
  
**What excites us is not how many P&C programmes you've run, but:**

* How well you understand why businesses behave the way they do
* How you read people beyond what they say out loud
* How confidently you can translate that understanding into sound, practical people decisions

This role is for someone who wants to earn trust before driving change, and who sees P&C not as a support function, but as a business-critical craft.
  
  
**How you'll make an impact:**
**Understanding Before Action**

* Your first responsibility is context.
* You'll spend time understanding how the business operates, how value is created, where teams struggle, and what truly motivates people here. Only then will you begin shaping people practices.

**Being a Real Business Partner**

* You'll work closely with business stakeholders - not as a support, but as a thinking partner.
* That means forming opinions, asking hard questions, and offering people-related advice that is grounded in business reality, not HR theory.

**Performance That Actually Means Something**

* You'll own and evolve the performance management ecosystem - from goal setting to feedback to outcomes.
* Not as a ritual, but as a system that helps people grow, leaders lead better, and the business perform stronger.

**Compensation, Rewards & Trade-offs**

* You'll work on compensation philosophy, salary bands, and reward structures - understanding that these are not just numbers, but signals.
* You'll help business stakeholders navigate difficult trade-offs with fairness, clarity, and sound judgment.

**Hiring with Judgment**

* You'll be deeply involved in behavioural fitment interviews and hiring decisions.
* Your role is to look past polished answers and assess real capability, behaviour, and fit - ensuring the right people enter the system.

Governance
**Without Bureaucracy**

* You'll own P&C policies and compliance with a strong sense of responsibility, not rigidity.
* This role also comes with the opportunity to work across geographies. You'll engage with people practices beyond India – particularly in the UK – and learn how people decisions change across legal, cultural, and operating contexts.

**Insights, Not Just Data**
You'll use people data to spot patterns - in attrition, engagement, performance, and growth - and turn those into insights leaders can act on.
  
  
**Who you are**
**:**

* You're seen as someone who understands both the business and have a pulse of people on ground
* Business members trust your judgment and seek your input on people decisions
* Your advice related to people feels intentional, not reactive
* You take ownership naturally - without needing reminders or guardrails
* You move fast when needed, and thoughtfully when it matters

**What we're looking for:**
We're looking for someone who:
  
  

* Experience of 10-12 years and has worked closely with business stakeholders in fast-moving, evolving environments.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information
* Thinks in systems but acts with pragmatism
* Has hands-on experience with performance management and compensation frameworks
* Uses data to inform judgement, not replace it
* Operates with a strong sense of ownership – 'the buck stops here'
* Is low on ego, high on accountability, and genuinely collaborative
* Exposure to UK P&C compliance and statutory requirements is a strong plus

**This Role May Not Be Right for You If**

* You prefer clearly defined tasks over open-ended responsibility
* You see P&C primarily as a support or service function
* You're uncomfortable challenging leaders or influencing tough decisions
* You're looking for a role where strategy and execution are neatly separated

**What you'll love:**

* Competitive compensation aligned to level and experience
* Insurance and standard benefits

**One last thing (and this matters)**
This role will stretch you.
  
  
It will ask you to think deeply, act decisively, and own outcomes - even when things are messy.
  
  
If that excites you more than it scares you, this role is likely a good fit.
  
  
**Though we've a work in hybrid model, flexibility to come in more regularly is required (either due to change in Company Policy in few months or critical seasonal deliverables)**
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.
  
  
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.
  
  
Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

title: Associate Recruiter
description:
**Job Description**

**Associate Recruiter**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Us**

Ratch AI is recruitment delivered as software. We are outcome-based: we hold ourselves accountable for the hire, not for the number of CVs we send. Every assessment a candidate goes through runs inside one platform, so every hire or no-hire call comes with structured evidence behind it. We call this decision intelligence.

Candidates are filtered tightly at every stage of the pipeline, so hiring managers spend their time only on the people worth meeting. Their judgement scales across every hire without costing them their calendar. We work with fast-scaling startups, and our in-house talent team runs live mandates end to end on the platform.

**Position Overview**

You will own mandates: one recruiter, one mandate, one scoreboard. Our talent intelligence analysts give you the map, covering target companies, role vocabulary, sample profiles and screening criteria. Your job is to turn that map into a shortlist that holds up under scrutiny, and to do it fast. Your mandates will span both technical roles such as software, DevOps and embedded engineering, and non-technical roles across finance, sales, business development, marketing and operations.

**What You'll Do**

* Source candidates from the mandate's intel brief using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards and niche communities, then cut long lists down to tight shortlists.
* Run high-volume outreach where every message still reads as though it was written for that one person.
* Screen hard against filters and disqualifiers, and reason a fast "no" as clearly as a "yes".
* Move candidates through assessments and client interview rounds within committed turnaround times.
* Keep your pipeline clean enough that anyone can see where each candidate stands and why.
* Report back to analysts what the market is telling you: who is moving, what they expect, and where the brief was wrong.
* Use AI tools every day, and flag it when you find a better way of working.

**What You'll Bring**

**Must-Have**

* 1-2 years in recruitment in an agency, RPO or startup setting. This role is not suited to freshers.
* Experience in a high-volume, numbers-driven environment that you genuinely enjoyed.
* Ability to switch from an engineering brief in the morning to a sales or finance brief in the afternoon without losing depth on either.
* High agency: when you are stuck, you have already tried three things before you ask.
* Daily use of AI tools in your own workflow, not just curiosity about them.
* Coachability: direct feedback lands, and you are visibly better the next day.

**Good-to-Have**

* Exposure to both technical and non-technical hiring mandates.
* Experience owning turnaround-time commitments on live mandates.
* Familiarity with structured screening and evidence-based candidate notes.
* Comfort giving market feedback that reshapes a brief.

**Logistics**

  Full-time
* **Job Function:**
  Talent Acquisition
* **Department:**
  Talent
* **Location:**
  Bengaluru, India
* **Experience:**
  1-2 years in recruitment
* **Work Mode:**
  In-office

title: Recruiter
description:
**Who we are**

With about 6,000-plus people across 34 countries, Michael Page connects people with roles that bring out their best, and helps teams find the talent they need. For 50 years, we’ve been changing lives by building a global network and a reputation customers trust.

We’re the world’s number one permanent recruiter. That means you’re backed by a strong global brand, and leaders who know their markets inside out.

We give our people what they need to do a great job, an inclusive culture that rewards performance, and the training, leadership and technology to help them grow. Our job is to set our people up for success, so every day can be a life‑changing one. Page makes it possible; you make it Page
**.**

**What will you be doing?**

The objective of the role is to support the delivery of our client's RPO and/or MSP hiring program. Working closely with Michael Page Outsourcing and key client stakeholders, you'll deliver on your roles each month, owning candidate generation and selection, working with hiring managers to take them through their shortlisted candidates for their respective roles, and then supporting the interview process. You'll then manage offer negotiations through to successful onboarding.

This role could see you working in various settings - remotely, in a Page Group office, or on-site within our clients' facilities. This potential variety will make it an interesting and dynamic environment.

We are looking for customer-focused individuals to join our Talent Acquisition Partners team. It is likely that you have worked in or supported recruitment previously and will have an inquisitive nature with a passion for helping people reach their potential by supporting their job search.

**Key Activities**

* Engage with the Talent Acquisition Manager and Hiring Managers to understand role requirements, overall expectations, timeframes, candidate pool quality and quantity
* Support the Account Director / Talent Acquisition Manager on monthly reporting at all stages of the recruitment process for review with the client. Inclusion of statistics on D&I applications and conversion rates

title: Account Manager
description:
**Account Manager / Senior Account Manager**

Bengaluru / Remote | 3–10 years

**About Target HR**

Target HR is a talent search firm for high-growth product companies from Seed to Series D. We help them hire across Product, Technology, Leadership, GTM, Sales and Marketing.

We work directly with Founders, CXOs, HR Leaders and Business Heads. Our job isn't to forward

profiles. We help clients understand the talent market, define who they actually need, and build their teams.

**The role**

As an Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of client relationships and become the go-to person for their hiring. The role combines client management, problem solving, recruitment and business growth.

**What you'll do**

• Partner with Founders, CXOs, HR Leaders and Hiring Managers on their most important hires.

• Understand the business behind each requirement, not just the JD.

• Define the right talent profile, target companies and search approach.

• Drive searches with our Recruiter's and Sourcer's, and keep the funnel moving.

• Manage interviews, feedback, offers and closures.

• Use market data, such as compensation, talent availability and candidate behaviour, to shape client decisions.

**Growing your accounts**

Business development here comes from the work itself, not cold calling. As you run searches, you'll build trust with founders and leaders. That trust leads to new mandates within your accounts and introductions to new companies. You'll own the growth of your portfolio.

**Why this role is interesting**

No two months look the same. You might run a Product leadership search for a Series C fintech, then help a B2B SaaS company build its GTM team, then work with a founder on their first leadership hires.

Over time, you'll learn how businesses are built, how teams are structured, and how talent decisions shape a company's trajectory. It's an education in startups as much as in recruitment.

**Who we're looking for**

• 3–10 years in recruitment, executive search, talent solutions, B2B sales, consulting or account

management.• You're genuinely curious about startups and how businesses work.

• You're comfortable with numbers and use data to make a case.

• You can own a client relationship end to end without close supervision.

• You want to grow into a larger business role, not stay in a desk role.

**Where this can go**

Start by owning a set of accounts. Grow them, build your own portfolio and revenue, and eventually your own team.

**Growth Path looks like : Account Manager**
→
**Business Lead**
→
**Vertical / P&L; Owner**

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Senior
description:
Rodeo FX is an award-winning creative company offering services in visual effects, animation, advertising and experiential. We partner with some of the world's leading storytellers and entertainment companies, including Netflix, HBO, Disney, Marvel, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros. and Sony.
  
  
In 2026, Rodeo FX opened its newest studio in
**Bengaluru**
, expanding our global network across Canada, the United States, Europe and India. Located in
**International Tech Park Bengaluru**
, the new 40,000-square-foot studio is designed to accommodate up to 400 artists and supports both Rodeo FX and Mikros Animation.
  
  
Our Bengaluru team is fully integrated into Rodeo FX's global pipeline, collaborating with artists, supervisors and production teams across our international studios on incredible projects.
  
  
We're now building the senior creative and technical leadership for this studio. Joining us at this stage means having the opportunity not only to contribute to world-class projects, but also to help shape the team, workflows and culture of a growing global hub.
  
  
**Work Arrangements**
As an artist-founded and artist-led company, creativity is at the heart of everything we do. Our mission is to give our talent the freedom, resources, and environment they need to produce high-quality work and thrive in a stimulating, collaborative, and supportive setting.
  
  
To support close collaboration, strong team connections, and the creative energy of our studio,
**all Bengaluru roles are expected to work from the studio five days per week**
. This on-site presence helps foster effective communication, faster decision-making, knowledge sharing, and a consistent studio culture across teams.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Talent Acquisition Specialist has a direct impact on our ability to deliver on production commitments. You identify hard-to-find talent, assess candidates with sound judgment, and help teams make timely, well-informed hiring decisions.
  
  
As Rodeo FX grows in Bengaluru, you will own recruitment mandates across specialized creative, production, and technical disciplines. You will partner closely with department heads, studio leadership, and the global Talent Acquisition team to shape search strategies, build talent communities, and guide candidates from first contact through signature.
  
  
*Every interaction with a candidate is an opportunity to leave a mark. We show up at every step, regardless of the outcome. This standard is a way of working, and it’s what we expect from you.*
**Main Responsibilities**
**Recruitment and hiring partnership**

* Own recruitment mandates from intake through signature, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, references, offer preparation, and negotiation.
* Lead intake discussions with hiring managers to clarify priorities, calibrate the required level, define success criteria, and agree on an efficient selection process.
* Advise hiring managers on candidate quality, market realities, compensation expectations, and trade-offs when decisions need to be made.
* Keep searches moving through proactive follow-ups, clear recommendations, and timely decisions.
* Partner with the Bengaluru studio team and global Talent Acquisition colleagues to align hiring activity with production priorities.

**Sourcing and talent communities**

* Develop targeted sourcing strategies for specialized roles across VFX, animation, production, and technology.
* Build relationships within Bengaluru’s talent market and the broader Indian creative and technical communities through direct outreach, referrals, professional networks, and relevant events.
* Maintain well-segmented talent communities and re-engage potential candidates as opportunities arise.
* Write accurate, engaging job postings and tailor outreach to the role, audience, and market.
* Share practical market insights on talent availability, compensation, competing opportunities, and potential hiring risks.

**Assessment and selection**

* Conduct structured screening interviews and assess candidates against the requirements agreed with hiring managers.
* Document relevant evidence, strengths, gaps, and risks in clear, actionable evaluation notes.
* Help interviewers prepare focused questions and contribute to consistent, well-documented debriefs.
* Identify concerns early and bring forward context and possible solutions.
* Exercise discretion, sound judgment, and care when handling candidate information and sensitive decisions.

**Candidate Experience And Operational Rigor**

* Give candidates clear expectations, timely updates, and respectful follow-up at every stage, including when they are not selected.
* Keep SmartRecruiters accurate and current so the team has a shared view of each candidate, decision, and next step.
* Coordinate interviews, feedback, references, and internal approvals with attention to detail.
* Prepare complete offer approval requests, including compensation, availability, proposed terms, and the rationale needed for a decision.
* Guide candidates through the offer and signature process in close coordination with the appropriate internal partners.

**Building the function**

* Help establish effective recruitment practices for the Bengaluru studio while working within Rodeo FX’s global Talent Acquisition standards.
* Identify friction in the hiring process, propose practical improvements, and share approaches that work.
* Contribute to local attraction initiatives, including industry relationships, academic partnerships, events, and employer branding.
* Represent Rodeo FX professionally within India’s VFX community and related industries.

**Qualifications**

* At least 5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or recruitment, including substantial ownership of full-cycle hiring mandates.
* A track record of partnering with hiring managers, managing multiple specialized searches, and influencing hiring decisions through clear recommendations.
* Strong direct sourcing skills, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, outreach, talent mapping, and sustained candidate engagement.
* Experience using SmartRecruiters or a comparable applicant tracking system to maintain accurate records and manage hiring workflows.
* Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to write clear candidate assessments and communicate effectively with colleagues across locations.
* Strong organization, prioritization, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* The judgment and autonomy to move searches forward while maintaining a high standard of candidate experience and documentation.
* Ability to work on-site at our Bengaluru studio five days per week.

**Distinctive assets**
Experience recruiting for VFX, animation, video games, or another creative production environment. Familiarity with roles and workflows across a VFX pipeline. Experience supporting a studio launch or a period of rapid growth. Established relationships within India’s creative talent communities. Experience collaborating with hiring teams across countries and time zones.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Rodeo FX, diversity is a core value. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, equitable workplace where different perspectives are embraced. Every team member brings unique insight that strengthens our creativity, challenges our thinking, and helps us deliver better work.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment**
Rodeo FX may use AI-based tools to support certain steps of the recruitment process, such as interview transcription or preliminary application analysis. These tools may be operated by third-party providers, and data may be processed outside Quebec. These tools never replace human decision-making: all final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers. To learn more about how we protect your personal information and your rights, please consult our Privacy Policy.
  
  
**Apply with LinkedIn**
If you would like to use the “Apply with LinkedIn” feature to simplify your application, please make sure you accept cookies on the SmartRecruiters application page. This allows the feature to display and function properly.

A senior advisory seat, not a coordination role. You will own Sales and GTM hiring end to end - advising leadership on the market, shaping every search, and closing the candidates who will build the revenue organisation. You will set the bar and the strategy, not just run the process.

**What you'll do?**

* Advise Sales and GTM leadership on talent strategy: market mapping, role design and where to hunt.

* Drive compensation strategy on offers: position, negotiate and close in a competitive market.
* Run full-cycle searches from calibration to close, holding a high bar at real pace.

**What you should have?**

* 12+ years of experience in Non-Tech Talent Acquisition, with deep, proven time hiring for Sales/GTM teams.

Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. We’re working with leading frontier labs to create the highest-quality, highest-diversity datasets for training robotics foundation models. **Assistant Manager – Operations**
to support and execute field data collection operations across multiple regions. Working closely with Pipeline, Inventory, Hardware, and QA teams, you will help ensure
**consistent, high-quality recordings are delivered every day**
.
  
  
**About IRL**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Building & Talent Management**

* Lead end-to-end hiring and onboarding of operations team members.
* Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of operators and team members.
* Create career development plans and coaching programs to improve team effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Training & Process Excellence**

* Design and implement training programs for new hires and existing team members.

* Monitor operational KPIs, productivity metrics, and quality standards.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable process improvements.

* Communicate project progress, challenges, and recommendations to customers and leadership teams.
* Drive customer satisfaction through proactive communication and operational excellence.

**Infrastructure & Operational Readiness**

* Ensure operational infrastructure, hardware, and tools are functioning effectively.
* Manage inventory, equipment allocation, and operational readiness across teams.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational issues quickly and efficiently.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in operations, account management, customer success, BPO, shared services, or technology-enabled operations.
* 2+ years of experience managing teams and leading people.
* Experience working in high-growth startups and scaling operations.
* Strong background in managing large enterprise accounts and customer-facing operations.
* Proven experience driving operational excellence in fast-paced environments.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience creating reports, dashboards, and operational reviews.
* Hands-on approach with a willingness to dive deep into execution when required.
* Highly proficient with AI tools, particularly ChatGPT, and able to leverage them to improve productivity, problem-solving, and workflow design.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, technology, operations, customer success, or enterprise services organizations.
* Experience managing large-scale operational teams.
* Familiarity with quality assurance frameworks and process improvement methodologies.
* Exposure to AI, data operations, annotation, content moderation, workflow management, or technology-enabled service delivery.
* Experience working with global customers and cross-functional teams.

**Why Join Us**

* Lead a critical operations function powering innovative AI-driven initiatives.
* Build and scale a team from the ground up.
* Work directly with customers and leadership on high-impact projects.
* Opportunity to shape processes, systems, and operational strategy.
* Competitive compensation along with benefits such as commute and meals.
* Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
**About The Team**
Walmart’s Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of building a future-ready workforce. We are a passionate and strategic team dedicated to identifying, engaging, and hiring exceptional talent that powers our business and serves millions of customers every day.
  
  
As part of the Leadership Talent Acquisition team, you will play a critical role in shaping Walmart’s technology leadership organization by identifying and attracting exceptional leaders from across the global technology ecosystem. You will work closely with senior executives and technology leaders to build leadership talent strategies, strengthen succession pipelines, and hire high-impact talent across Walmart Global Tech.
  
  
This role will have a strong focus on Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior technical leadership roles, requiring deep expertise in executive search, passive talent engagement, market intelligence, talent mapping and strategic stakeholder management.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead Senior Leadership Hiring
  
  
Own end-to-end recruitment for Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior leadership and critical technology roles across Walmart Global Tech.
  
  
Partner directly with senior executives, VPs, hiring managers and HR leadership to understand business strategy, organization design, workforce plans and leadership talent requirements.
  
  
Translate complex business and technology needs into targeted leadership hiring strategies and compelling talent propositions.
  
  
Lead highly confidential and business-critical searches with a strong focus on quality, speed, candidate experience and organizational fit.
  
  
Build Executive Talent Strategies & Pipelines
  
  
Develop proactive talent strategies for critical leadership and future capability needs rather than relying solely on active applicants.
  
  
Build and maintain deep, diverse and market-mapped leadership talent pools across India and global technology markets.
  
  
Identify and engage passive leadership talent from leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
  
  
Develop long-term relationships with senior technology executives and high-caliber technical leaders, including candidates who may not be actively seeking opportunities.
  
  
Build succession-ready external talent pipelines for strategic and hard-to-fill leadership positions.
  
  
Executive Search & Talent Mapping
  
  
Conduct sophisticated research and talent mapping across technology ecosystems to identify relevant leadership talent.
  
  
Leverage executive search methodologies, market intelligence, professional networks, AI-enabled sourcing tools and industry relationships to identify exceptional talent.
  
  
Develop talent maps covering leadership capabilities, organizational structures, technology expertise, career progression and relevant market pools.
  
  
Build targeted competitive intelligence on talent movements, leadership changes, organizational expansions, layoffs, acquisitions and emerging technology hubs.
  
  
Establish relationships with senior leaders and external talent communities to strengthen Walmart’s leadership talent brand.
  
  
Strategic Stakeholder Partnership
  
  
Act as a trusted talent advisor to senior business and technology leaders, providing insights beyond the recruitment process.
  
  
Challenge hiring assumptions constructively and influence decisions through data, market intelligence and talent availability.
  
  
Consult with leaders on talent strategy, role calibration, market positioning, compensation considerations and competitive hiring dynamics.
  
  
Establish clear search strategies, candidate profiles, assessment expectations and decision-making frameworks at the beginning of each search.
  
  
Facilitate alignment across multiple senior stakeholders and ensure disciplined governance throughout the hiring process.
  
  
Candidate Engagement & Experience
  
  
Personally engage and build relationships with senior candidates throughout the hiring journey.
  
  
Develop compelling, personalized value propositions for leadership candidates based on their career aspirations, technology interests and leadership impact.
  
  
Serve as a trusted advisor to candidates while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism throughout the process.
  
  
Deliver a differentiated, high-touch "white-glove" candidate experience for senior leadership hires.
  
  
Effectively manage complex offer discussions, compensation expectations, counteroffers and closing strategies.
  
  
Market Intelligence & Talent Insights
  
  
Provide senior leadership with actionable insights on technology talent markets, competitor organizations, leadership movements and compensation trends.
  
  
Track market availability and competitiveness for critical leadership capabilities.
  
  
Analyze candidate response, conversion, offer acceptance and hiring trends to continuously improve leadership recruiting strategies.
  
  
Develop data-driven recommendations to improve Walmart's ability to attract and hire senior technology talent.
  
  
Build strong understanding of technology domains including AI/ML, Cloud, Data, Software Engineering, Platforms, Infrastructure, Product Engineering and emerging technologies.
  
  
Thought Leadership & Team Capability
  
  
Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader for leadership talent acquisition within the organization.
  
  
Mentor and coach recruiters on advanced sourcing, executive engagement, stakeholder management and closing strategies.
  
  
Share market intelligence, sourcing strategies, candidate insights and best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  
  
Contribute to building scalable leadership hiring frameworks, playbooks and talent intelligence capabilities.
  
  
Represent Walmart Global Tech externally as a talent ambassador and strengthen relationships with senior technology talent communities.
  
  
Governance & Operational Excellence
  
  
Ensure all leadership hiring activities follow Walmart's recruiting processes, compliance requirements and governance standards.
  
  
Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data within ATS and talent management systems.
  
  
Establish disciplined search governance, including search strategy, pipeline reviews, interview progress, decision tracking and closure.
  
  
Use recruitment analytics and funnel metrics to identify opportunities for improving search effectiveness and hiring outcomes.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
15+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience, with significant experience hiring senior technology leadership.
  
  
Proven experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, VP, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow or equivalent senior technology leadership talent.
  
  
Demonstrated success managing complex, confidential and high-impact leadership searches.
  
  
Strong understanding of the global technology talent ecosystem and leadership talent markets, particularly across India.
  
  
Deep expertise in executive sourcing, passive candidate engagement, talent mapping and market intelligence.
  
  
Strong network among senior technology professionals and leaders across leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
  
  
Ability to understand complex technology organizations, architectures, products and engineering capabilities and translate them into effective talent strategies.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and hiring leaders using data, market insights and sound talent judgment.
  
  
Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, relationship-building, negotiation and influencing skills.
  
  
Experience managing complex stakeholder groups across business, technology, HR, compensation and Talent Acquisition.
  
  
Strong understanding of executive compensation, competitive talent dynamics and offer negotiation strategies.
  
  
Proficiency with ATS platforms, talent intelligence tools, LinkedIn and AI-enabled sourcing/recruiting technologies.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert recruiting data and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple strategic searches and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.
  
  
High degree of confidentiality, integrity, discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive leadership searches.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience recruiting senior technology leaders within large-scale global technology organizations.
  
  
Experience partnering with C-suite, VP-level stakeholders.
  
  
Experience building leadership talent pools and succession pipelines proactively.
  
  
Exposure to hiring across multiple geographies and relocating global technology talent into India.
  
  
Experience using AI, talent intelligence platforms and data-driven sourcing methodologies to identify and engage executive talent.
  
  
Experience in building executive talent communities and long-term relationships with senior technology leaders.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
In this role, success goes beyond filling open positions. You will be expected to:
  
  
Build a strong and sustainable pipeline of senior technology leadership talent.
  
  
Increase Walmart's access to high-caliber passive leadership talent.
  
  
Deliver exceptional candidates for the most strategically important technology roles.
  
  
Become a trusted talent advisor to senior technology leadership.
  
  
Bring actionable external market intelligence into leadership hiring decisions.
  
  
Strengthen Walmart's ability to attract, engage and close senior technology leaders in a highly competitive market.
  
  
Build scalable approaches for identifying and engaging future leadership talent before positions become open.
  
  
Elevate the candidate experience for senior leadership and executive-level hiring.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**About Hyphenate**

**Hyphenate**
(formerly Maximor.ai) is a New York-based startup, founded in 2023 by former Microsoft executives, building AI agents that automate finance and accounting workflows for mid-market and enterprise companies. The platform connects directly to ERP, CRM, billing, payroll, and banking systems to handle tasks like revenue recognition, accounts payable, and reconciliation — replacing the manual, Excel-driven work that has traditionally bogged down finance teams during month-end close. Hyphenate has raised $9M in seed funding led by Foundation Capital, with participation from Gaia Ventures, Boldcap, and others.

**About the Role**

Hyphenate is hiring an India-based Technical Recruiter to own outbound sourcing and closing for U.S. software engineering and technical roles. This is a hands-on, outbound-first sourcing role for someone who has already closed engineering hires for a U.S. product company and is comfortable running cold outreach at volume.

**Work Schedule & Hours**

This is a remote role based in India that supports a U.S. hiring team. Please note the following before applying:

* **6-day work week.**
  The role operates on a six-day schedule (Monday through Saturday).
* **Late India-time hours.**
  Working hours are shifted later in the day (IST) to provide meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours for candidate calls, hiring-team syncs, and scheduling.
* **Flexibility on both sides.**
  Exact hours will be agreed with the Head of Talent and may flex around candidate availability across U.S. time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end sourcing and outbound recruitment for U.S.-based software engineering and technical roles.
* Design and run outbound campaigns — cold email sequences and cold calling — to build qualified candidate pipelines.
* Use AI-enabled sourcing tools to identify, enrich, and prioritize candidate lists.
* Manage candidate communication end-to-end: outreach, screening, scheduling, and pipeline updates.
* Partner closely with the hiring team to refine sourcing criteria based on candidate quality and market feedback.

**Required Experience**

* 2–4 years of full-cycle recruiting experience at a fast-growing, U.S.-based startup (seed through Series B).
* Startup experience must be from a product company — SaaS, AI agents, or enterprise software. E-commerce and non-product companies do not qualify.
* Track record of having sourced and closed multiple U.S.-based software engineering roles — this is a minimum bar, not a nice-to-have.
* Strong, demonstrated experience with outbound recruitment: cold email campaigns and cold calling. Inbound recruiting experience is a plus but not required.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of the day-to-day sourcing workflow.
* Able to commit to a 6-day work week with late India-time hours aligned to U.S. business hours.
* Consistent, stable work history — frequent unexplained employment gaps will not meet the bar.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with modern AI-powered sourcing platforms such as Juicebox or MetaView.
* Experience with sourcing/outreach tools commonly used for U.S. technical hiring, such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, hireEZ (formerly Hiretual), SeekOut, GitHub (with tools like Octohunt), and Wellfound (formerly AngelList Talent).

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Very competitive pay.**
  Compensation benchmarked well above market for the role and experience level.
* **Performance-based bonus.**
  Additional earnings tied to hiring outcomes and pipeline quality.

**Hiring Process**

* **Round 1 — Screening:**
  Introductory conversation with the Hyphenate Head of Talent.
* **Round 2 — Task:**
  A short take-home exercise (a few hours) to assess sourcing approach and output.
* **Round 3 — Paid Work Trial:**
  Successful candidates move to a one-week, paid work trial using Hyphenate's own tools and live requisitions.
* **Final Round:**
  A closing conversation with Hyphenate leadership.
