description:
**TL;DR:**
We're hiring an HR Head to run people operations across two companies: Zinc & Broccoli, our ~20-person design studio, and SCPL, our sister print and packaging facility with ~45 people on the production floor. It's a new role. You'll be the only dedicated HR professional across both, building hiring, performance reviews, exits and POSH compliance from the ground up, and taking day-to-day people issues off management's desk. We are not looking for freshers, but for someone who has atleast 3 years of manufacturing industry experience, and who's looking for a challenging role to grow their skills conceptually (and not just on paper).

**How to Apply:**

Email me at raksha@zandb.in with:

* Your resume, attached
* Years of HR experience, how many of those were in a generalist or HR lead role, and how many on a manufacturing shopfloor (name the company and roughly how many workers you covered)
* Your Kannada level: conversational, professional or mother tongue
* One engagement activity you ran for manufacturing or production staff: what it was, who it was for, and what impact did it have
* One people issue you handled on your own, start to finish: what happened, what you did, how it ended. A short paragraph in your own words is perfect.
* Your salary expectations (CTC in LPA). Our budget for this role is 8 to 9 LPA
* Why this role interests you specifically

**Role:**

As HR Head, you'll own people operations at Z&B and SCPL: hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, exits, employee concerns, POSH compliance and HR records. You'll report directly to management and settle routine people matters yourself.

3 to 5 years of HR experience, with at least 1 to 2 years in a generalist or HR lead role and hands-on shopfloor exposure.

**100% on-site, full-time position at our office at Yelachanahalli, Kanakapura Road.**

**What This Role Is NOT:**

* Part of an HR team. You are the HR function, and there are no current plans to expand it
* A desk-bound policy role. Expect to spend real time with designers at the studio and with operators and supervisors at SCPL
* A role for escalating routine decisions. Leave approvals, minor conflicts and policy questions should stop with you
* Remote or hybrid

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Short-term (1 to 2 years):**

* Own all people operations across Z&B and SCPL: hiring, exits, performance, engagement and HR administration
* Run the KRA/KPI framework and the performance review cycle, with structured periodic 1:1s and formal appraisals across both organisations, every one of them documented
* Handle hiring end to end: JD creation, job posting, screening, interview coordination, offers and onboarding for all roles
* Manage exits, including resignations, notice periods, offboarding checklists and exit interviews
* Deal with employee concerns, interpersonal conflicts and policy queries independently, so management isn't pulled in
* Set up POSH compliance: form the Internal Committee, train every employee across both companies, and act as first point of contact for complaints

**Medium to long-term (2 to 3 years):**

* Build candidate pipelines for recurring roles to cut time-to-hire
* Work with management to spot skill gaps and organise training on a regular cadence
* Design engagement and team-building programmes that suit both a design studio and a packaging production floor
* Help shape HR policy and organisational design as both companies grow

**Key Result Areas (KRAs):**

These are the results we expect from bringing you on board, and they'll decide your growth path and future promotions:

* Measurable reduction in management time spent on routine HR tasks and people issues
* Consistent, documented hiring and exit processes across Z&B and SCPL
* Performance review cycles completed on schedule and accurately
* Better employee engagement and retention, on the studio side and the production side
* Clean HR records and full compliance with Z&B and SCPL policies
* Further goals, KPIs and project plans will be discussed during the interview process and onboarding.

**Basic Terms of Employment:**

* Permanent, full-time, on-site role with Zinc & Broccoli at our Kanakapura Road office
* Working hours: our day starts between 09:00 and 10:15, usually 9-hour workdays, Monday to Friday, plus 2 working Saturdays a month
* 6 months' probation (no paid leaves during probation)
* 2 months' notice period if employee wishes to terminate the contract

**Skills and Tools Required:**

* 3 to 5 years of HR experience, including at least 1 to 2 years in a generalist or HR lead role
* Hands-on HR experience on a manufacturing shopfloor is mandatory; exposure to creative studios or professional services is an advantage
* Experience running engagement activities for production or factory staff
* Experience owning performance management and KPI tracking
* Strong written and verbal English
* Conversational Kannada is mandatory
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Excel is mandatory; experience with HRMS tools such as PagarBook is a plus
* Discretion and maturity with sensitive employee matters
* Organised, process-driven and comfortable working independently with minimal hand-holding

**Thanks for reading! This is how it works:**

I (Raksha Sharma, Studio Director & Partner at Zinc & Broccoli) read every application that comes into my inbox. If you've read this far and answer exactly what's asked, you're already ahead of most of the applicants. I'll call you first, then we'll set up an interview in person at the office. There are two rounds of interviews at the office before the role is finalised. I've posted this job opening for the third time this year, because the previous two times brought an overwhelming number of resumes to sift through. I've changed the application process now, hoping this lands me the right person (and then I can hand over this process to you!)

**About Zinc & Broccoli**

Zinc & Broccoli is a communication design studio specialising in B2B marketing communications for manufacturing and technology companies. We turn complex technical concepts into clear, visually strong marketing material for clients around the world who value strategic design thinking and real collaboration. Learn more at www.zandb.in

**About SCPL**

SCPL is a Bengaluru-based printing and production company, part of the same founding group. It runs a full-service print and packaging facility with production staff, machine operators, supervisors and management staff. Learn more at www.scpl.net

title: Manager Consulting
description:
**Meet Our Team**
At Pega, we believe that our greatest asset is our people.
**Within our dynamic Consulting organization serving global clients**
, we understand that success comes from both developing exceptional talent and delivering outstanding results. Our
**Consulting Managers**
play a vital role - they shape the future of our talent while ensuring project delivery in excellence, creating an environment where both our people and our projects thrive.
  
  
**Picture Yourself At Pega**
Imagine yourself in a role where you're not just leading teams - you're transforming them. As a Consulting Manager, you'll spend approx. 75% of your time designing and implementing structured mentorship programs, creating specialized development tracks, and nurturing the next generation of Pega leaders. The remaining 25% of your focus will be on driving strategic initiates successfully through effective governance and delivery.
  
  
Regular skill assessments and gap analysis are central to how our Consulting Managers drive continuous improvement. They create personalized learning and development roadmaps for each team member, facilitating peer learning and knowledge-sharing sessions to promote collaboration. Through mentoring partnerships between senior and junior members, our Consulting Managers encourage both individual growth and collective team success.
  
  
We believe in identifying and nurturing emerging leaders. Our Consulting Managers provide targeted leadership development programs, empowering team members to lead special initiatives and projects. Succession planning ensures that we are always prepared to fill key roles with capable leaders from within our team
  
  
They organize team-building activities that foster collaboration and trust, ensuring that everyone feels valued and supported. Recognition programs celebrate outstanding contributions, while open platforms for innovation encourage creative problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  
  
Our Consulting Managers are passionate coaches who provide structured, actionable feedback to help team members set and achieve ambitious goals. Through regular career development discussions, they guide personal brand development and support everyone’s journey to success within the company.
  
  
At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**

* Performance Excellence
* Team Engagement and Culture
* Professional Growth Framework
* Coaching Excellence
* Change Management and Adaptation
* Driving Strategic Initiatives
* Program Management and Governance
* Client Relationship Management

**Who You Are**

* You are a visionary leader who excels at both people development and project delivery. With a strategic mindset, you understand how to balance nurturing talent with achieving project success.
* With a strong background in managing talent in an IT consulting & delivery organization, you thrive in guiding individuals through their career growth and helping them achieve their full potential.
* You have a natural ability to foster an inclusive, engaging, and collaborative culture, and you understand the importance of continuous learning and professional development.
* You are a proactive problem-solver who is committed to performance excellence and driving results.
* You know how to leverage data-driven insights to assess skills, identify gaps, and create personalized development plans that ensure both individual and organizational success.
* You are skilled in coaching and providing constructive feedback, and you are always looking for opportunities to help your team members stretch their abilities and develop new skills.
* You’re a leader who values diversity and innovation, and you enjoy building strong relationships with team members at all levels.
* Whether you’re supporting emerging leaders, leading change, or providing mentorship, you are dedicated to fostering growth and resilience in others.
* You also excel at navigating change and supporting teams through transitions with a focus on maintaining high morale and engagement.
* Above all, you are someone who believes in the power of people and understands that empowering others to succeed is the key to building a thriving organization.

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  
  
You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You've Accomplished**

* You have 8-12 years of overall IT experience and 3-5 years in Managing People in a matrix type of IT Consulting organization (GTM)
* You have demonstrated success in project delivery leadership roles in client facing environments
* You’ve successfully developed and implemented mentorship and growth programs that have advanced careers across all levels. Your focus on personalized development and skill assessments has consistently improved team capabilities and identified future leaders.
* You’ve built a culture of collaboration and innovation, driving team engagement through recognition, team building, and learning opportunities.
* Your coaching and feedback have empowered individuals to set and achieve challenging goals, aligning them with the company’s long-term vision.
* You’ve led teams through change, fostering adaptability and high performance while balancing business needs with team well-being.
* You’ve been a key driver in building high-performing teams ready for the future.

**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
A career here is life-enhancing.
  
  
At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video
**here**
.
  
  
Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.
  
  
Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.
  
  
At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.
  
  
For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist plays a critical role in leading end-to-end recruitment efforts, ensuring the organization attracts, engages, and hires top talent aligned with business needs and culture. This role partners closely with senior leadership, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to design and execute recruitment strategies, streamline processes, and drive efficiency. The Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist contributes to strategic HR and organizational initiatives and supports the continuous improvement of recruitment practices, employer branding, and talent pipeline development.
  
  
**WORK LOCATION:**
Remote position based in Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, or Mumbai, with pan-India operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as needed.)
  
  

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for India-based hiring, including intake meetings, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate assessment, and offer management.
* Partner with senior leadership and hiring managers in India and globally to develop recruitment strategies aligned with business priorities and workforce planning needs.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse) and sourcing platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed) to effectively manage recruitment activities and identify qualified talent.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, and ongoing candidate relationship management.
* Ensure timely communication and consistent updates throughout the recruitment process to deliver a positive and professional candidate experience.
* Collaborate closely with business functions, to recruit for technical and business-critical roles across India.
* Support or contribute to organizational initiatives beyond core recruitment responsibilities, including onboarding workstreams, process alignment, and the development of tools and resources that support the broader organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and streamline recruitment processes while supporting consistency across India and global talent acquisition practices.
* Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring teams by providing insights on the India talent market, candidate availability, compensation trends, sourcing strategies, and recruitment best practices.
* Ensure recruitment activities are conducted in alignment with company policies, established processes, and applicable employment practices and requirements in India.

**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree required (Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field preferred); MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience, with demonstrated experience recruiting within the India talent market.
* Proven experience supporting technical and business functions in a corporate or professional services environment
* Experience within life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, engineering, or consulting industries required.
* Strong knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Greenhouse), sourcing platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed), and end-to-end recruitment workflows.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and stakeholders across different functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Skilled in leveraging recruitment data and metrics to track performance, identify trends, and improve hiring outcomes.

**Skills And Attributes**

* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively engage candidates, hiring managers, and senior leaders.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience supporting cross-functional and global initiatives.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

title: HR Recruiter - Production Factory
description:
HR Recruiter

**Company:**
Tholasi Prints India Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Designation:**
HR Recruiter / Recruitment Executive

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent

**Work Location:**
On-site

About the Company

Tholasi Prints India Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based printing and packaging company with operations in offset printing, commercial printing, digital printing and packaging. The company has its manufacturing operations in the Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru.

Job Summary

We are looking for a
**proactive and result-oriented HR Recruiter**
to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for the company's production, packaging, sales, administrative and support functions.

The HR Recruiter will be responsible for sourcing suitable candidates, conducting initial screening, coordinating interviews, maintaining recruitment records and ensuring timely closure of manpower requirements.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Manpower Planning & Recruitment**

* Understand manpower requirements from Production, Sales, Administration and other departments.
* Source candidates for both
  **blue-collar and white-collar positions**
  .
* Handle recruitment for operators, production staff, supervisors, team leaders, sales staff, executives and support staff.
* Ensure vacancies are closed within the required timelines.

**2. Candidate Sourcing**

* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment agencies, social media, employee referrals, local recruitment networks and other channels.
* Develop a strong database of candidates, particularly for manufacturing and printing-industry positions.
* Conduct local-area recruitment drives whenever required.
* Maintain an updated candidate pipeline for frequently required positions.

**3. Screening & Interview Coordination**

* Screen resumes and applications based on job requirements.
* Conduct preliminary telephonic/face-to-face interviews.
* Assess candidates for experience, skills, communication, salary expectations, availability and suitability.
* Coordinate technical and management interviews with concerned departments.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining.

**4. Joining & Documentation**

* Coordinate pre-joining formalities and document collection.
* Verify candidate documents and employment information as per company requirements.
* Prepare and maintain joining documentation.

title: MSP Program Specialist
description:
***Company Overview:***

*Workspend is a leading global provider of contingent workforce management solutions for Fortune 500/Global 2000 clients. Workspend is one of the fastest growing companies in the industry and currently supports over 40 clients to manage their temporary workforce and total talent solutions. Workspend is an innovative company, and we are using the latest innovative technologies to disrupt the workforce industry.*

**Job Summary:**

The Program Specialist is responsible for supporting temporary/contingent workforce programs for our clients. The Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with our Employer-of-Record (EOR) provider, hiring managers and staffing suppliers to support and manage the full lifecycle for the requisition process including requisition intake, shortlisting, supplier sourcing management, onboarding, worker assignment management, time and expense, offboarding and reporting. The Program Specialist acts as a talent advisor and strategic business partner to support our clients and ensure requisition fulfillment for quality talent in a timely manner. The role offers an excellent opportunity for someone to learn strong leadership skills and grow in their careers

**Responsibilities:**

* Managing hiring manager relationships and at times interacting with client’s executive leadership to ensure all contingent labor needs are fulfilled.
* Coordinate with the Employer-of-Record provider to facilitate the onboarding of client-identified workers. Activities will include, but are not limited to:
* Ensure accurate and complete information has been provided in the VMS.
* Facilitate transfer of information to EOR provider to ensure worker details are captured accurately and completely, with the goal of providing a timely and smooth onboarding process for workers.
* Serve as a communication intermediary between EOR provider and client Hiring Managers, ensuring timely information transfer.
* Serve as an escalation point for EOR provider related to matters pertaining to rate of pay, assignment details and duration, background check requirements and adjudication, etc.
* Provide timely communication to client Hiring Managers related to working onboarding status and availability to start.
* Review status of, and take action on, compliance items in VMS to facilitate worker onboarding.
* Managing the staffing and requisition fulfillment process – ensuring that the client’s needs are being met. Including, but not limited to:
* Assisting client managers during all stages of the contract labor acquisition process including: requisition intake, sourcing, candidate shortlisting and interviewing
* Document requirement intake conversations in appropriate database (VMS etc.)
* Discuss with HM agree upon expectations, timeframes, feedback, roles and responsibilities of everyone involved in the requisition fulfilment process
* Work with and communicate with staffing suppliers to make sure that proper feedback, projections, and critical communications are being relayed in a timely manner.
* Facilitation of on-boarding and off-boarding of contractors
* Maintain the VMS (vendor management system) with strong attention to details of staffing, hiring and on boarding process of the contingent workforce. This will include updating the system with rate changes, processing contract extensions, processing releases/terminations and updating other data as necessary.
* Document all client/supplier reported issues and track resolution through to completion ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
* Accurate and on-time completion of reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Monitor and address issues and concerns with the contingent workforce quickly and effectively; escalate issues to management as needed.
* Assist with development of presentation and customer facing items (QBRs, Operational reviews, Dashboard reviews, other), with support from leader.
* Assist with worker assignment management (cost center changes, extension of contract assignments etc.) to maintain data integrity
* Liaison with managers, vendors and security department to ensure all necessary paperwork is completed and collected prior to starting assignments and at end of assignments
* Ensure all work orders are closed in the system with accurate finish reasons when notified of an end of assignment and appropriate departments are notified (i.e., security).
* Work hand in hand with the program management team to ensure metrics, SLAs, and targets are being met.
* Serve as a professional representative of Workspend to the client – solving problems and diligently following up to ensure best in class service to the client.
* Participate in client meetings to review strategic initiatives and assist with PMO roadmap/initiatives

**Mandatory skills:**

* Minimum 2-3 years’ experience supporting clients for their temporary workforce hiring and management either for an Employer-of-Record (EOR) provider, temp/contingent staffing MSP or a temp staffing master vendor program.
* Experience in high volume coordination activities (interviewing, on-boarding, etc.).
* Experience with MS Office (Excel, Word, PPT) and PC skills.
* Able to work independently with minimal direction required for core daily responsibilities.
* Medium level of direction needed for advanced responsibilities.
* Excellent communication skills including client relationship management.
* Detail oriented with strong analytical skills.
* Should be a quick learner and motivation to continue to grow in your career.
* Customer Focused.

**Education/Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 2-3 years of relevant experience

*Workspend is an EEOE. Workspend offers an entrepreneurial culture and endless opportunity to grow for the right and motivated individuals. Looking for candidates who are driven and are looking to grow to next level in their careers. Should be responsible and take ownership.*

*Workspend offers an attractive compensation package and benefits that include health insurance, flexible paid time off and other benefits.*

title: Director - India Staffing Operations
description:
**Overview:**

TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.

**Position: Director - India Staffing Operations**

**Location: Bangalore, Karnataka**

**Job Type: Full Time**

**Work Type : Onsite**

**Job Description:**

* We are looking for an exceptional Director – India Staffing Operations to build, lead and scale our Bangalore Staffing organization.
* This is not a role to inherit an established team.
* This is a build-from-the-ground-up leadership opportunity.
* The successful leader will be responsible for establishing Bangalore as a high-performing staffing and recruitment hub for TekWissen—building the team, creating the operating culture, developing delivery capabilities, establishing client relationships and scaling the business.
* The individual will be expected to be physically present in the Bangalore office every working day, working closely with leadership, recruiters, clients and the broader organization.
* We are looking for a leader who can simultaneously think like an operator, business builder, client leader and people leader.

**The mandate is simple:**

* Build the team.
* Build the culture.
* Build the clients.
* Build the delivery engine.
* Build Bangalore.

**The Opportunity:**

* TekWissen is expanding its India Staffing presence in Bangalore and is looking for a leader who can take ownership of this expansion and turn it into a significant business unit.
* The Director will initially operate with a highly entrepreneurial mindset, personally driving critical activities while simultaneously building the leadership structure required for scale.
* The role will encompass:
* India Staffing Operations
* Recruitment Delivery
* Client Management
* New Business Development
* Team Building
* Workforce Planning
* Process & Quality
* Performance Management
* P&L / Commercial Ownership
* Culture Building
* Bangalore Market Development
* Over time, the leader will build a substantial organization with multiple layers of management and specialized recruitment teams.

**Your Mission:**

* Build Bangalore into one of TekWissen's strongest India Staffing delivery and growth centers.
* You will be responsible for creating an organization that can:
* Win clients → Build teams → Deliver at scale → Retain clients → Expand accounts → Create sustainable revenue.
* You will not simply manage operations.
* You will build the operation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Build the Bangalore Staffing Organization:**

* Own the complete organizational build-out from the ground up.
* Develop the Bangalore staffing organizational structure.
* Define initial hiring requirements across recruiters, sourcing, team leaders, managers and support functions.
* Hire and develop the first layer of leadership.
* Build recruitment teams aligned to different staffing verticals.
* Establish clear reporting structures and accountability.
* Develop succession plans as the organization scales.
* Create a high-performance staffing culture.
* The expectation is to evolve the organization from a small initial team into a scalable staffing operation.

**Own Staffing Delivery:**

* Take complete ownership of recruitment and staffing delivery performance.
* Drive:
* Requirement coverage
* Sourcing
* Candidate submissions
* Interview conversions
* Offers
* Joins
* Time-to-fill
* Quality of hire
* Submission-to-interview ratio
* Interview-to-offer ratio
* Offer-to-join ratio
* Client satisfaction
* Recruiter productivity
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms that create visibility and accountability.

**Build a High-Performance Recruitment Engine:**

* Create the operating model that allows the Bangalore organization to scale without compromising quality.
* Develop:
* Recruiter productivity frameworks
* Sourcing models
* Skill-based recruitment teams
* Hunting & farming models
* Recruiter specialization
* Talent pools
* Market intelligence
* Candidate pipelines
* Referral programs
* Recruitment analytics
* Delivery dashboards
* Quality governance
* Continuously identify ways to improve productivity through technology, AI, automation, data and process innovation.

**Build the Leadership Team:**

* The Director will personally recruit and develop the leadership layer required to scale the business.
* Potential leadership structure may include:
* Director – India Staffing
* General Managers / Senior Delivery Managers
* Delivery Managers / Recruitment Managers
* Team Leads
* Recruiters / Sourcers
* The successful candidate will determine the right structure based on business requirements and growth.

**Be a Client Builder:**

* Although this is primarily an operations leadership role, the successful leader must also be commercially oriented.
* During the initial phase, the Director will personally contribute to winning new clients and expanding the Bangalore business.
* Responsibilities include:
* Identify potential staffing clients in Bangalore and across India.
* Leverage existing industry relationships to open doors.
* Engage CHROs, TA Heads, Procurement leaders and business leaders.
* Participate in client meetings and solution discussions.
* Support proposals and staffing solutions.
* Help convert initial relationships into active staffing programs.
* Expand existing accounts through delivery excellence.
* The expectation is not to become a traditional salesperson.
* Rather:
* Build the business by combining operational credibility with strong client relationships.

**Become the Face of Bangalore Staffing:**

* This is a highly visible leadership role.
* The Director will represent TekWissen's India Staffing organization in the Bangalore market.
* The leader will:
* Represent TekWissen at staffing and HR forums.
* Build relationships with senior HR and TA leaders.
* Participate in industry events.
* Develop Bangalore's staffing ecosystem.
* Build relationships with local business communities.
* Represent TekWissen with clients, partners and employees.
* Help establish TekWissen as a recognized staffing brand in Bangalore.
* We are looking for someone who naturally becomes a market-facing leader and industry connector.

**Own Performance & Operating Metrics:**

* Create a data-driven staffing organization.
* Establish dashboards covering:

**Delivery**

* Open Requirements
* Requirements Covered
* Submissions
* Interviews
* Offers
* Joins
* Time-to-Fill
* Aging Requirements

**Productivity**

* Recruiter Productivity
* Submission Productivity
* Interview Conversion
* Offer Conversion
* Join Ratio
* Quality Metrics

**Business**

* Active Clients
* New Clients
* Revenue
* Gross Margin
* Client Growth
* Account Expansion
* Placement Share

**People**

* Headcount
* Attrition
* Performance
* Hiring Needs
* Training
* Internal Mobility

**Build the Culture:**

* We are looking for someone who understands that staffing is ultimately a people business.
* The Director will create an environment built around:
* Accountability
* Ownership
* Speed
* Collaboration
* Learning
* Recognition
* Performance
* Transparency
* Innovation
* Build an environment where high performers want to stay, grow and take leadership responsibility.

**Develop Talent:**

* Create a structured development ecosystem for recruiters and managers.
* This includes:
* Recruitment training
* Client-specific training
* Market intelligence
* Technology training
* AI-enabled recruitment
* Leadership development
* Career paths
* Performance coaching
* Manager development
* The objective is to create leaders from within the organization, not continuously depend on external hiring.

**Technology & AI Transformation:**

* Build a modern staffing organization.
* Identify opportunities to leverage:
* AI sourcing
* Candidate matching
* Recruitment automation
* ATS intelligence
* Recruitment analytics
* Generative AI
* Automated reporting
* Market intelligence
* Predictive hiring analytics
* The expectation is to continuously ask:
* "How can we deliver more with better technology, better data and better people?"

**Client Delivery Excellence:**

* Establish strong governance across key accounts.
* Conduct regular client reviews.
* Establish account health metrics.
* Identify delivery risks early.
* Develop improvement plans.
* Ensure SLA adherence.
* Monitor recruiter allocation.
* Build client-specific delivery strategies.
* Drive account expansion opportunities.
* The goal is to move beyond transactional staffing toward strategic client partnerships.

**Commercial & P&L Responsibility:**

* As the Bangalore business scales, the Director will progressively take ownership of:
* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Headcount economics
* Productivity
* Client profitability
* Delivery costs
* Business growth
* Forecasting
* The leader should understand the economics of staffing and make decisions based on both growth and profitability.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Must Have:**

* 12+ years of experience in India Staffing, Recruitment, RPO or Workforce Solutions.
* Significant leadership experience managing large recruitment/delivery organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale teams.
* Strong understanding of the Indian staffing market.
* Strong client management capabilities.
* Proven delivery ownership.
* Excellent people leadership skills.
* Strong understanding of staffing metrics and commercial models.
* Ability to operate independently and build a business.
* Willingness to work from the Bangalore office every working day.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

* A Builder
* You have built teams before—not simply inherited them.
* A Staffing Leader
* You understand recruitment economics, delivery, clients, recruiters and the realities of staffing operations.
* A Client Leader
* You can sit across the table from a CHRO or TA Head and confidently represent TekWissen.
* A People Leader
* You know how to attract, develop, motivate and retain high-performing recruitment professionals.
* A Business Builder
* You understand that operations and business development are connected.
* A Market Leader
* You have relationships and credibility within the Bangalore HR, staffing and recruitment ecosystem.
* A Culture Creator
* You can create the identity, energy and standards of a new office.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* First 90 Days
* Establish Bangalore operating structure.
* Hire critical leadership and recruitment positions.
* Define delivery processes and KPIs.
* Establish operating dashboards.
* Begin building the client pipeline.
* Establish relationships with key Bangalore market stakeholders.
* Create the initial staffing culture.
* 6 Months
* Establish a stable and productive recruitment organization.
* Build strong client relationships.
* Win initial new staffing accounts.
* Establish predictable delivery performance.
* Build the next layer of recruitment leadership.
* Establish Bangalore as a credible TekWissen staffing hub.
* 12 Months
* Build a significant staffing organization.
* Establish multiple delivery verticals.
* Develop a strong client portfolio.
* Create predictable revenue growth.
* Build a high-performing management layer.
* Establish strong employee engagement and retention.
* Create a scalable operating model for further expansion.

**The Leadership Opportunity:**

* This role offers an opportunity to build something that will carry your leadership signature.
* You will have the opportunity to shape:
* The team.
* The culture.
* The client base.
* The operating model.
* The leadership structure.
* The Bangalore brand.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :**
Custom Software Engineering Lead
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Supplier Contract Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Strategic Sourcing / IT Procurement, RFx Management (RFI/RFP/RFQ)
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE

The Sourcing SME owns the end-to-end sourcing cycle for assigned IT categories within the extended VMO — from sourcing strategy and RFP execution through supplier evaluation, contract award, and post-award contract support. The role ensures every sourcing event is run with discipline and rigour: clear scope and evaluation criteria up front, a fair and well-documented evaluation process, a defensible award decision, and a clean handover into contract execution and vendor governance.
  
  
The Sourcing Manager works closely with Technology, Legal, Finance and InfoSec stakeholders throughout the cycle, and feeds sourcing outcomes into the VMO's governance artefacts (Obligations Traceability Matrix, Savings Pipeline) to ensure a seamless transition from sourcing into steady-state vendor management..
  
  
1.1 Strategic Sourcing & Tendering
  
  
Own the sourcing pipeline and RFP/RFI/RFQ governance for all IT categories across assigned topics.
  
  
Absorb and independently operate the tendering knowledge, tools and templates.
  
  
Develop category sourcing strategy for IT categories, aligned to business objectives, budget & financial targets.
  
  
Partner with stakeholders and business/technology leads to establish requirements, scope and evaluation criteria ahead of each sourcing event.
  
  
1.2 Running the RFP (RFI / RFP / RFQ Execution)
  
  
Develop and issue RFI/RFP/RFQ documentation — requirements, scope, evaluation criteria, timelines and commercial terms.
  
  
Manage bidder communications, clarification cycles and Q&A sessions throughout the bid period.
  
  
Ensure bid documentation clearly defines scope, inclusions/exclusions, assumptions and commercial structure to support clean comparison across bidders.
  
  
1.3 Evaluation
  
  
Evaluate and analyse incumbent and potential suppliers against established evaluation and selection criteria — cost, technical fit, service levels, risk and (where applicable) ESG factors.
  
  
Perform bid analysis and leveling (scope, inclusions/exclusions, assumptions, schedule impact) to ensure like-for-like comparison across proposals.
  
  
Facilitate a cross-functional evaluation committee (Technology, Legal, Finance, InfoSec) and consolidate scoring into a clear, defensible recommendation.
  
  
1.4 Contracting Support and Awarding
  
  
Support commercial negotiations — pricing structure, payment terms, SLAs, warranties and key risk clauses — in coordination with Procurement.
  
  
Support contract drafting and finalisation with Legal, ensuring terms and conditions accurately reflect RFP and negotiation outcomes.
  
  
Prepare award recommendations based on evaluation scoring and secure the appropriate governance/approval sign-off.
  
  

* REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

9+ years of dedicated Sourcing & Procurement experience, with a strong IT/technology category focus.
  
  
Post Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
Demonstrated track record running full sourcing cycles — from RFP through evaluation, award and contract support — delivering measurable cost savings..
  
  
Strong negotiation experience on contracts of significant value, covering pricing, SLAs, payment terms and risk allocation
  
  

* KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Strong RFx process discipline and documentation rigour.
  
  
Analytical skills for bid analysis, TCO modelling and weighted evaluation scoring.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

title: Talent Acquisition, HR & Founder's Office
description:
Okay Done is a digital marketing agency with a diverse clientele, such as Royal Challengers Bengaluru, OnePlus, VRL, Google, Bengaluru City Police, Heineken, and Health Care Global to name a few. We work across various industries, including sports, consumer, hospitality, luxury, F\&B, real estate and D2C.
 



  





**Overview**




 Location: Bengaluru \| Type: Full\-time, onsite \| Experience: 2 to 4 years
 



  





**Read This First**




 If things slip through your fingers, this role is not for you.
 



  





 That is the single hardest filter we have, and we are not going to be shy about it. In one day you will move between a candidate you are chasing, a letter that has to go out, a calendar that keeps changing, and a vendor waiting on an answer. Four different jobs before lunch.
 



  





 Most people can do any one of those well. Very few can do all four in the same day without dropping one. The ones who drop one usually do not notice they dropped it, which is the actual problem.
 



  





 If you are the person who remembers the thing everyone else forgot, keep reading.
 



  





**The Role, Honestly**




 Three jobs in one, and all three are apprenticeships.
 



  






 Talent acquisition.
 
 You find people. Then you learn how we pick them, because how we hire is genuinely different from how most agencies do it, and it is the reason the work here is good. You will be taught this directly by the Partner and the Managing Partner. Not from a course, not from a recruitment SOP. From sitting in on the calls and then being handed the next one.
 



  






 HR.
 
 The paperwork, the sheets, the attendance, the onboarding. Unglamorous, and the reason everything else works.
 



  






 Founder's office.
 
 You sit beside the people running this company. The calendar, the follow ups, the things that need chasing, the decisions that need turning into action. You will see how the business is actually run, from the seat where it happens.
 



  





 Do all three well and you will understand how a company is staffed and run within a year. Most people take five.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do**




 • Scout talent. Hunt across LinkedIn, portfolios, Instagram, campuses, referrals, and places nobody else is looking. Build pipelines before we need them, not after. A good scout has three names ready the day a role opens.
 



 • Learn our way of hiring. Sit in on screening calls with the Partner and the Managing Partner. Watch what they ask and understand why. Then start running first rounds yourself.
 



 • Run the hiring process end to end. Job posts, applications, shortlists, scheduling, feedback, closing the loop with everyone. Candidates should never be left wondering where they stand.
 



 • Own the paperwork. Offer letters, appointment letters, onboarding documents, exit formalities. Accurate, on time, no typos in someone's name or their number.
 



 • Keep the sheets clean. Attendance, leave, candidate trackers, employee records. If a sheet is out of date, that is on you and only you.
 



 • Onboard people properly. First day sorted, laptop sorted, accounts sorted, introductions made. Nobody's first impression of this place should be confusion.
 



 • A bit of internal ops. Not content ops, we already have someone excellent on that. This is the managerial side. Vendor coordination, office and admin running, internal approvals, keeping small processes from becoming big problems. It is a slice of the job, not the job.
 



  





**Who You Are**




 •
 **You are frighteningly organized.** 




 • You read people quickly. You will be the first human every candidate speaks to. Within one call you should have a real opinion on whether they are worth the founders' time.
 



 • You speak and write well. How you sound is how this company looks to everyone applying to it.
 



 • You are not a pushover. You will have to tell a senior person their meeting is moving, or that their document is late. You do it politely, firmly, every time.
 



 • You notice details. Wrong date on a letter, a name spelled two ways, a mismatch between two sheets. You catch it before anyone else does.
 



 • You close loops. You do not leave a message unanswered or a task half done because nobody followed up. You are the follow up.
 



 • You are hungry, coachable, and allergic to mediocrity.
 



  





**About Experience**




 We are looking for 2 to 4 years of work experience. Not zero, because you should already know what a workplace feels like and how to talk to people senior to you. Not ten, because this is a role you grow into and we would rather build the habits with you than undo someone else's.
 



  





 What that experience was in matters far less. HR, recruitment, sales, operations, hospitality, teaching, a family business, something else entirely. We will teach you recruitment, documentation, and how this company runs. What we cannot teach is how you carry yourself, whether you notice things, and how badly you want it.

title: People Lead (Talent Acquisition & HR)
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
   

  

  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote and/or Bangalore
* Working days: Monday–Saturday
* Working with: Founders (mostly CEO \& COO)


 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white\-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're a recruiting company. That means the bar for how we hire our own team is higher, not lower. If our own hiring is slow or sloppy, we have no business selling hiring to anyone else.
   

  

 This role owns both halves of people at Weekday: bringing the right people in, and building the place they want to stay. Roughly half your time goes into talent acquisition — planning hiring with the founders, running pipelines, closing senior candidates. The other half goes into HR — policies, performance, compensation, engagement, compliance — for a team of around 50–70 people that keeps growing.
   

  

 There is no HR department waiting for you. There is some process, some of it good, much of it built on the fly. You'll decide what to keep, what to fix, and what to build from scratch. You'll do the work yourself before you hire anyone to do it for you.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 On any given day you might be:
   

  

  

* Working with the founders on the hiring plan and owning it: which roles, in what order, at what bar
* Running senior and hard\-to\-fill hires yourself — sourcing on the Weekday platform, pitching, closing, negotiating
* Setting up the hiring machine: scorecards, interview loops, work trials, and a candidate experience we'd be proud to show customers
* Designing and running performance reviews, goal\-setting, and feedback cycles that people actually take seriously
* Building the basics properly: policies, compensation bands, leave, payroll, and labour\-law compliance
* Owning onboarding, engagement, and retention — and reading attrition data honestly, including the ugly numbers
* Being the person the team trusts with hard conversations — conflicts, underperformance, exits


 You'll be measured on whether things got done — well, and on time. Not on slides.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

  

* 2–5 years across talent acquisition and HR. You've been the first or second people hire somewhere, or you've built people ops at a startup that was scaling fast
* You've recruited hands\-on and closed senior hires yourself — not just managed agencies
* You have strong judgment on people. You can tell a good hire from a good interviewer
* You're a builder, not a policy\-keeper. You write the process when there isn't one, and you cut it when it stops helping
* You communicate directly — no padding, no spin — and you can say no to a founder when it's the right call
* You know Indian labour law and payroll basics well enough to keep us compliant without a consultant on speed dial
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace


 Nice to have
   

  

  

* Experience at a recruiting, HR\-tech, or staffing company
* Comfort with tools like Airtable, Slack, Notion, or an HRMS \- and a habit of automating repetitive work


 What you get
   

  

  

* Full ownership of people function at a profitable, venture\-backed startup \- the culture you build is the one that sticks
* Direct partnership with the founders on every hiring and people decision
* India's largest white\-collar talent database and our outbound tools, for your own hiring
* A front\-row seat to how a company scales, and the chance to build the team that does it


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**Senior Recruiter** 




**Ratch AI** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \|
 **Experience:** 
 4\+ years \|
 **Work mode:** 
 Full\-time \|
 



  





**About Ratch** 




 Ratch AI is recruitment delivered as software (
 *Service\-as\-a\-Software* 
 ), and it's outcome\-based: we're accountable for the hire, not for the number of CVs we send.
 



 Every assessment a candidate goes through runs inside one platform, so each hire/no\-hire call comes with structured evidence behind it. We call this decision intelligence. Candidates are filtered tightly at every stage of the pipeline, so hiring managers spend their time only on people worth meeting. Their judgement scales across every hire without costing them their calendar.
 



 We work with fast\-scaling startups and Global Capability Centres. Our in\-house talent team runs live mandates end\-to\-end on the platform, so you'll see how AI\-native hiring works from the inside.
 



  





**The role** 




 You own mandates from intake to joining. Our talent intelligence analysts give you the map, which covers target companies, role vocabulary, sample profiles and screening criteria. You turn it into hires: you shape the brief with the hiring manager, run the search, hold the bar through every stage, and close the candidate.
 



 Your mandates will span both technical roles (software, DevOps, embedded and other engineering) and non\-technical roles (finance, sales, business development, marketing and operations), often at the same time. As the team grows, you'll also set the standard that our associate recruiters learn from.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Run intake like a consultant.** 
 Pressure\-test the hiring manager's brief, separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves, and push back when the ask doesn't match the market.
* **Own the search.** 
 Work from the analysts' intel brief, go beyond it where needed, and deliver tight shortlists that hold up under scrutiny.
* **Hold the bar.** 
 Screen hard against filters and dis\-qualifiers, move candidates through Ratch assessments and client rounds, and stick to committed turnaround times.
* **Close.** 
 Manage compensation conversations, counter\-offers and notice periods, and stay with the candidate until they join.
* **Manage the client relationship.** 
 Give hiring managers clear, evidence\-backed updates and make sure they're never surprised by a pipeline status.
* **Sharpen the system.** 
 Tell analysts what the market is actually saying, flag where a brief was wrong, and help us improve how the platform filters and evaluates people.
* **Raise the team.** 
 Review associate recruiters' shortlists and outreach, and coach them through hard mandates.



  





**Who you are** 



* You have 4\+ years of end\-to\-end recruitment experience, from intake through offer and joining, across both technical and non\-technical roles.
* You've closed hires in agency, RPO or fast\-growing in\-house settings, and you can walk us through the numbers behind them.
* You can hold your ground with a senior hiring manager and change their mind with evidence rather than opinion.
* You can switch from an engineering brief in the morning to a sales or finance brief in the afternoon without losing depth on either.
* You already use AI tools in your own workflow and have a view on where they help and where they don't.
* You still care about craft. Years in the job haven't made you settle for a CV\-forwarding routine.



  





**What this role is not** 




 It isn't a steady 9\-to\-5 with a predictable pace. You'll be measured on hires closed, quality of shortlists and turnaround times, not effort or hours logged. Feedback here is direct and frequent. If you're looking for a role where seniority means doing less, this isn't it.
 



  





**What you get** 



* Full ownership of mandates across a wide mix of roles and clients
* A front\-row seat to how hiring decisions get made with evidence instead of opinion
* Direct working proximity to the founding team, with real influence on how our recruitment process and platform evolve
* Room to grow into leading a recruiter pod as the team scales

description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Beyond day\-to\-day hiring, you'll play a key role in shaping and rolling out TA initiatives and projects including recruitment campaigns \& marketing, diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging hiring, and our Global TA transformation.
   

  

**Meet our team** 
 \-
   

  

 The TA team is based out of Bangalore in India.
   

  

 The hiring TA team is responsible for achieving headcount needs for the Engineering \& Products organization.

Additionally, you'll engage closely with leaders on the site, the broader HR community, and the Global GTA team.

* Conduct thorough pre\-screen activities in line with PayPal and job requirements, and presents a shortlist and recommendations of the most suitable candidates for consideration for assigned requisitions.

* Represent the Talent Acquisition team positively in relationships and communication with the Human Resource Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, business leaders, and other Global Talent Acquisition team members.


**What Do You Need To Bring\-**

 PayPal

 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. title: Principal Recruiter
description:
**About The Team**
 Walmart’s Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of building a future\-ready workforce. We are a passionate and strategic team dedicated to identifying, engaging, and hiring exceptional talent that powers our business and serves millions of customers every day.
   

  

 As part of the Leadership Talent Acquisition team, you will play a critical role in shaping Walmart’s technology leadership organization by identifying and attracting exceptional leaders from across the global technology ecosystem. You will work closely with senior executives and technology leaders to build leadership talent strategies, strengthen succession pipelines, and hire high\-impact talent across Walmart Global Tech.
   

  

 This role will have a strong focus on Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior technical leadership roles, requiring deep expertise in executive search, passive talent engagement, market intelligence, talent mapping and strategic stakeholder management.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 Lead Senior Leadership Hiring
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end recruitment for Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior leadership and critical technology roles across Walmart Global Tech.
   

  

 Partner directly with senior executives, VPs, hiring managers and HR leadership to understand business strategy, organization design, workforce plans and leadership talent requirements.
   

  

 Translate complex business and technology needs into targeted leadership hiring strategies and compelling talent propositions.
   

  

 Lead highly confidential and business\-critical searches with a strong focus on quality, speed, candidate experience and organizational fit.
   

  

 Build Executive Talent Strategies \& Pipelines
   

  

 Develop proactive talent strategies for critical leadership and future capability needs rather than relying solely on active applicants.
   

  

 Build and maintain deep, diverse and market\-mapped leadership talent pools across India and global technology markets.
   

  

 Identify and engage passive leadership talent from leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
   

  

 Develop long\-term relationships with senior technology executives and high\-caliber technical leaders, including candidates who may not be actively seeking opportunities.
   

  

 Build succession\-ready external talent pipelines for strategic and hard\-to\-fill leadership positions.
   

  

 Executive Search \& Talent Mapping
   

  

 Conduct sophisticated research and talent mapping across technology ecosystems to identify relevant leadership talent.
   

  

 Leverage executive search methodologies, market intelligence, professional networks, AI\-enabled sourcing tools and industry relationships to identify exceptional talent.
   

  

 Develop talent maps covering leadership capabilities, organizational structures, technology expertise, career progression and relevant market pools.
   

  

 Build targeted competitive intelligence on talent movements, leadership changes, organizational expansions, layoffs, acquisitions and emerging technology hubs.
   

  

 Establish relationships with senior leaders and external talent communities to strengthen Walmart’s leadership talent brand.
   

  

 Strategic Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

 Act as a trusted talent advisor to senior business and technology leaders, providing insights beyond the recruitment process.
   

  

 Challenge hiring assumptions constructively and influence decisions through data, market intelligence and talent availability.
   

  

 Consult with leaders on talent strategy, role calibration, market positioning, compensation considerations and competitive hiring dynamics.
   

  

 Establish clear search strategies, candidate profiles, assessment expectations and decision\-making frameworks at the beginning of each search.
   

  

 Facilitate alignment across multiple senior stakeholders and ensure disciplined governance throughout the hiring process.
   

  

 Candidate Engagement \& Experience
   

  

 Personally engage and build relationships with senior candidates throughout the hiring journey.
   

  

 Develop compelling, personalized value propositions for leadership candidates based on their career aspirations, technology interests and leadership impact.
   

  

 Serve as a trusted advisor to candidates while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism throughout the process.
   

  

 Deliver a differentiated, high\-touch "white\-glove" candidate experience for senior leadership hires.
   

  

 Effectively manage complex offer discussions, compensation expectations, counteroffers and closing strategies.
   

  

 Market Intelligence \& Talent Insights
   

  

 Provide senior leadership with actionable insights on technology talent markets, competitor organizations, leadership movements and compensation trends.
   

  

 Track market availability and competitiveness for critical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 Analyze candidate response, conversion, offer acceptance and hiring trends to continuously improve leadership recruiting strategies.
   

  

 Develop data\-driven recommendations to improve Walmart's ability to attract and hire senior technology talent.
   

  

 Build strong understanding of technology domains including AI/ML, Cloud, Data, Software Engineering, Platforms, Infrastructure, Product Engineering and emerging technologies.
   

  

 Thought Leadership \& Team Capability
   

  

 Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader for leadership talent acquisition within the organization.
   

  

 Mentor and coach recruiters on advanced sourcing, executive engagement, stakeholder management and closing strategies.
   

  

 Share market intelligence, sourcing strategies, candidate insights and best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization.
   

  

 Contribute to building scalable leadership hiring frameworks, playbooks and talent intelligence capabilities.
   

  

 Represent Walmart Global Tech externally as a talent ambassador and strengthen relationships with senior technology talent communities.
   

  

 Governance \& Operational Excellence
   

  

 Ensure all leadership hiring activities follow Walmart's recruiting processes, compliance requirements and governance standards.
   

  

 Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data within ATS and talent management systems.
   

  

 Establish disciplined search governance, including search strategy, pipeline reviews, interview progress, decision tracking and closure.
   

  

 Use recruitment analytics and funnel metrics to identify opportunities for improving search effectiveness and hiring outcomes.
   

  

 What You’ll Bring
   

  

 15\+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience, with significant experience hiring senior technology leadership.
   

  

 Proven experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, VP, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow or equivalent senior technology leadership talent.
   

  

 Demonstrated success managing complex, confidential and high\-impact leadership searches.
   

  

 Strong understanding of the global technology talent ecosystem and leadership talent markets, particularly across India.
   

  

 Deep expertise in executive sourcing, passive candidate engagement, talent mapping and market intelligence.
   

  

 Strong network among senior technology professionals and leaders across leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
   

  

 Ability to understand complex technology organizations, architectures, products and engineering capabilities and translate them into effective talent strategies.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and hiring leaders using data, market insights and sound talent judgment.
   

  

 Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, relationship\-building, negotiation and influencing skills.
   

  

 Experience managing complex stakeholder groups across business, technology, HR, compensation and Talent Acquisition.
   

  

 Strong understanding of executive compensation, competitive talent dynamics and offer negotiation strategies.
   

  

 Proficiency with ATS platforms, talent intelligence tools, LinkedIn and AI\-enabled sourcing/recruiting technologies.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert recruiting data and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple strategic searches and deliver results in a fast\-paced, highly matrixed environment.
   

  

 High degree of confidentiality, integrity, discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive leadership searches.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience recruiting senior technology leaders within large\-scale global technology organizations.
   

  

 Experience partnering with C\-suite, VP\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience building leadership talent pools and succession pipelines proactively.
   

  

 Exposure to hiring across multiple geographies and relocating global technology talent into India.
   

  

 Experience using AI, talent intelligence platforms and data\-driven sourcing methodologies to identify and engage executive talent.
   

  

 Experience in building executive talent communities and long\-term relationships with senior technology leaders.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 In this role, success goes beyond filling open positions. You will be expected to:
   

  

 Build a strong and sustainable pipeline of senior technology leadership talent.
   

  

 Increase Walmart's access to high\-caliber passive leadership talent.
   

  

 Deliver exceptional candidates for the most strategically important technology roles.
   

  

 Become a trusted talent advisor to senior technology leadership.
   

  

 Bring actionable external market intelligence into leadership hiring decisions.
   

  

 Strengthen Walmart's ability to attract, engage and close senior technology leaders in a highly competitive market.
   

  

 Build scalable approaches for identifying and engaging future leadership talent before positions become open.
   

  

 Elevate the candidate experience for senior leadership and executive\-level hiring.
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

 India Staffing Delivery

 10\+ years in domestic staffing, including 3\+ years in a delivery leadership role
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 The Delivery Manager – India Business will lead end\-to\-end recruitment delivery for requirements generated by business development and existing client accounts. The role is accountable for building a high\-performing delivery team, translating client demand into practical hiring strategies, improving speed and quality of fulfilment, and delivering a consistently strong stakeholder experience. The successful candidate will combine hands\-on knowledge of the India staffing market with disciplined operational management, data\-led decision\-making, and strong client partnership skills.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Delivery leadership:** 
 Own recruitment delivery across assigned India business accounts and ensure fulfilment against agreed priorities, timelines, quality standards, and service levels.
* **Team management:** 
 Lead, coach, and develop recruiters and team leads; set clear goals, allocate workloads, review performance, and build succession capability.

 Convert client requirements and workforce plans into sourcing, screening, assessment, and closure strategies suited to the India talent market.
* **Client partnership:** 
 Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and hiring managers, clarify requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely delivery updates and market insights.
* **Pipeline governance:** 
 Review requisition health, ageing, funnel conversion, recruiter productivity, offer status, joining risk, and fulfilment forecasts through regular operating reviews.

 Maintain consistent screening, documentation, candidate communication, data privacy, and statutory or client\-specific compliance standards throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* **Stakeholder collaboration:** 
 Partner with business development, account management, sourcing, operations, HR, and finance teams to align capacity, priorities, commercials, and delivery commitments.

 Identify bottlenecks, standardize effective practices, improve turnaround time, and use automation and recruitment technology to strengthen efficiency and candidate experience.

 Anticipate delivery risks, resolve account or candidate issues promptly, and implement corrective actions to protect client relationships and business outcomes.
* **Market intelligence:** 
 Track talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring, location dynamics, and emerging skill demand across India, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Resource and budget management:**

 Key Success Measures
 


* Requisition fulfilment and closure ratio
* Time to shortlist, time to offer, and time to join

* Ageing control and hiring forecast accuracy
