title: Technical Recruiter
description:
At Meolaa, tech talent is our bottleneck. We're building D2C infrastructure, data pipelines, marketplace integrations, and systems that need to scale from ₹1Cr to ₹100Cr ARR. We need someone who understands what good engineering looks like, can source in a competitive market, and moves fast without hiring people who'll slow us down.
 



 The role is Tech Recruiter.
 



 The reality is you own the engineering hiring roadmap, and you own quality.
 



  





 What does that actually mean?
 



 It means on Monday you're convincing a Backend engineer why Meolaa's problem is more interesting than the Stripe offer they just got.
 



 On Tuesday you're breaking down the CTO's roadmap into hiring needs how many DevOps engineers do we need for Q2?
 



 On Wednesday you're doing final interviews and making the call on your top 3 candidates.
 



 On Thursday you're handling competing offers and negotiating with engineers who have leverage.
 



 On Friday you're presenting hiring pipeline health to the CTO, candidate quality, time\-to\-hire, pipeline depth.
 



 No two weeks look the same. Every week you're moving the needle on team composition.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴
 


* Build and own Meolaa's employer brand in the tech community
* Source engineers from GitHub, communities, conferences, referrals not just LinkedIn
* Build relationships with engineering leaders and CTOs
* Know what's hot (AI engineers, DevOps) and what's cold (dying tech stacks)
* Be known as the person who connects good engineers to interesting problems



 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲
 


* Build Boolean search strings that actually return quality candidates
* Source across roles — Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA, Data engineers
* Maintain a warm pipeline of pre\-screened candidates (never scrambling)
* Know the difference between a good engineer and a good interviewer
* Build sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill roles (DevOps, ML engineers)



 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘵𝗿𝗼𝗹
 


* Screen candidates technically enough to know good from mediocre
* Brief your interview team on who's coming and what to probe
* Debrief after interviews and make hiring recommendations (not just pass candidates through)
* Own candidate experience make Meolaa a place people
 *want* 
 to work
* Flag red flags early if someone's a flight risk, you should see it



 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
 


* Own hiring timelines CTO says "I need a DevOps engineer by Month 3," you own that
* Maintain pipeline health 3–4 candidates in process for each open role
* Manage competing offers and counter\-offer strategically
* Keep candidates warm through the process — silence kills pipelines
* Own time\-to\-hire metrics and identify bottlenecks



 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗿𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆
 


* Work with the CTO to understand hiring needs before they feel the pain
* Build job descriptions that don't sound like every other startup post
* Coordinate with People Ops on compensation bands, offers, onboarding
* Track retention of hires you've made if they leave in 6 months, you know why
* Be a thought partner to engineering leadership on hiring strategy



 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
 


* Own first 90 days for engineering hires smooth onboarding, clear expectations
* Follow up on new hires at 30/60/90 days catch problems early
* Build relationships with engineers so they feel supported
* Flag flight risks and help leadership retain key people
* Track why people leave and feed insights back to improve hiring



  





 You might be the one if
 


* You have 3–6 years of tech recruiting experience
* You've filled engineering roles and built engineering teams
* You understand technology well enough to have real conversations with engineers
* You know the difference between full\-stack and backend, and why it matters
* You've sourced engineers outside LinkedIn (communities, GitHub, referrals)
* You've dealt with competing offers and know how to retain talent
* You can read a resume and know if someone's actually good or just has buzzwords
* Prior experience in D2C, startups, or consumer tech is a strong plus
* You know Bangalore's tech talent market — where they are, what they care about, what they're paid
* You think like a matchmaker you're matching people to problems they care about, not just filling positions



  





 Why Meolaa?
 



 We're building tech that's not trivial. D2C platform, marketplace integrations, supply chain visibility, data pipelines — engineers here solve real problems. That's attractive to good engineers. Your job is to find them and convince them this is more interesting than another FAANG role.
 



 You'll have a CTO who actually cares about hiring right. You'll have budget. And you'll have autonomy to source aggressively without permission at every step.
 



 This isn't a volume recruiting role.
 



 This is a quality hiring role at a company that values engineering.

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition (Skillz)
description:
**About The Company**
 If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career.
   

  

 Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real\-money, skill\-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real\-stakes competition possible at scale.
   

  

 Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi\-million dollar franchises by enabling real\-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI\-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI\-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000\+ daily tournaments. $7\.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.
   

  

 We're a high\-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. We operate like a startup, hold ourselves to high standards, and move fast with purpose. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters — and be part of a team that fights for what it builds — Skillz is the right place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Skillz is looking for a Manager, Talent Acquisition to join our Bangalore team as second\-in\-command to the Senior Manager, TA. This is a hybrid role that blends hands\-on recruiting with day\-to\-day team leadership. You'll own priority searches yourself while coaching and guiding a team of recruiters to hire high\-quality talent across our technical and business functions.
   

  

 You'll play a direct role in driving recruiting profitability: cutting time\-to\-fill, growing our direct\-sourcing capability, and reducing our reliance on external agencies. At the same time, you'll build team capacity through coaching, consistent hiring standards, and hands\-on problem\-solving — stepping in as the Senior Manager's delegate to keep recruitment operations running smoothly as hiring demand grows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as second\-in\-command to the Senior Manager, TA; serve as their delegate, ensuring continuity of recruitment operations, and escalating risks in their absence.
* Own full\-cycle recruiting for priority and hard\-to\-fill roles across technical, product, data, and business functions, with an emphasis on sourcing Tier 1 talent from B2C technology companies.
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership to a team of recruiters including coaching, setting clear expectations, reviewing performance, and delivering feedback that improves productivity.
* Build and maintain direct\-sourcing pipelines and market maps to reduce agency dependency and raise quality of hire.
* Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to turn workforce priorities into structured search strategies and measurable hiring plans, constructively pushing back on requirements when needed.
* Track funnel metrics, conversion rates, and requisition ageing to spot bottlenecks and resolve operational blockers across the team's portfolio.
* Uphold hiring standards and process consistency to protect candidate experience and hit timelines.
* Lead offer negotiations and closing conversations, managing compensation expectations and counteroffers to land great talent within budget.
* Build lasting relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and stakeholders across the business.
* Support the Senior Manager, TA in driving down time\-to\-fill and minimizing the productivity loss that comes with open roles.


**Key Competencies**
* Team Leadership \& Coaching — guiding recruiters, setting expectations, and improving team performance.
* Technical \& Business Acumen — fluent in evaluating engineering, product, and data talent from Tier 1 B2C companies.
* Strategic Recruiting — translating priorities into search strategies, market maps, and hiring plans.
* Stakeholder Management — building credibility with leaders and constructively challenging requirements.
* Execution \& Accountability — strong ownership of outcomes, timelines, and candidate experience.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making — using metrics to spot risk and improve outcomes.
* Problem\-Solving \& Adaptability — resolving bottlenecks and thriving amid shifting priorities.
* Offer Negotiation \& Closing — managing compensation conversations and counteroffers with confidence.
* Relationship Building — sustaining trust across candidates, recruiters, and stakeholders.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record hiring technical, product, data, or business talent.
* 1–2\+ years formally managing, mentoring, or leading recruiters day\-to\-day.
* Demonstrated success hiring Tier 1 talent from B2C technology, consumer internet, gaming, fintech, e\-commerce, travel\-tech, food\-tech, or other scaled consumer businesses.
* Experience running priority or hard\-to\-fill searches independently while overseeing other recruiters' delivery.
* Strong direct\-sourcing skills; experience with building market maps and proactive pipelines without heavy reliance on agencies.
* End\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle experience: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debriefs, references, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Background in a startup, turnaround, or fast\-scaling environment where priorities shift quickly.
* A track record of tenure and growth; ideally two\-plus years at one or more organizations, with internal promotions or expanded scope.
* Genuine interest in gaming, consumer technology, and digital products.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate and work regularly from the Skillz Bangalore office.
* Background hiring for B2C tier\-1 profiles at B2C tech companies (not consulting/agency\-side).


**Location:** 
 Hybrid in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Travel Requirement:** 
 Less than 10%
   

  

**Why Skillz**
* You're building infrastructure, not just features. Skillz is the competition layer for mobile gaming — the matchmaking, payments, identity, and fraud systems that make real\-stakes competition trustworthy at scale. The work here compounds. Every improvement to the platform makes every tournament on it better.
* Founder\-led. Andrew Paradise founded Skillz in 2012 with a single conviction: that fair, real\-money skill\-based competition should exist at scale. Thirteen years later, he’s taken the company public on the NYSE, built a portfolio of three independent businesses, earned 90\+ patents, and won the largest false advertising verdict in U.S. history. He is still here — still the founder, still the CEO, still building. That kind of long\-term commitment and alignment is rare in any company. At Skillz, it defines the culture from the top down.
* Part of a compounding ecosystem. Skillz is one of three businesses inside FIRY — alongside RZR, our AI\-powered performance ad network, and Beamable, our developer backend platform. Your work spans gaming, ad tech, identity, payments, and ecommerce. The platform you build on gets smarter and more valuable with every player, developer, and advertiser that enters the ecosystem.
* Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre\-tax benefit options, and more.
* Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays.
* Las Vegas Headquarters. Skillz operates in a five\-day\-a\-week, collaborative office environment at our 36,000\+ square foot Las Vegas HQ. Free daily catered lunch, snacks, a full\-size gym with showers, commuter benefits, team events, and more.
* Recognized Success. Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.


 Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!
   

  

 Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. We look forward to having you on board!
   

  

 Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
 *.*

The platform is trusted by organizations including Highradius, Incorta, Kantata, Movius, Rillet, Coupa, and Naehas. Learn more at refold.ai.

Manager – Talent Acquisition (Lateral & Leadership Hiring)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Miles Education is looking for a Talent Acquisition professional to own lateral hiring portfolio, reporting directly to the VP\-HR. This is not a high\-volume recruiting role. It is a targeted headhunting mandate for roles where there is no inbound applicant pool to draw from: leadership hires, specialized functional roles, and positions where the wrong hire has outsized cost.
 



  





 The candidate should be someone who has run executive or specialist searches independently, is comfortable being the credible voice in the room with function heads, and reports on search progress with the same rigor a retained search firm would.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 ● Own end\-to\-end hiring for all lateral and niche requirements.
 



 ● Build and execute lateral sourcing strategy: direct headhunting, market mapping, executive networks, LinkedIn Recruiter, niche platforms.
 



 ● Run searches independently for roles with no meaningful inbound pipeline.
 



 ● Own time\-to\-close and quality\-of\-hire for every search, with data to defend both.
 



 ● Report directly to VP\-HR on every active search: pipeline status, market realities, risk flags.
 



 ● Partner with function heads to pressure\-test role briefs before a search opens, not after it stalls.
 



 ● Push back on unrealistic briefs (comp, timeline, candidate profile) with market evidence, not deference.
 



 ● Build and maintain live talent maps for specialist roles.
 



 ● Track competitor hiring, comp benchmarks, and talent movement relevant to Miles' functions.
 



 ● Maintain a warm bench of passive candidates ahead of anticipated openings, not after a req opens.
 



 ● Own the full candidate lifecycle for every lateral hire, from first outreach to offer close.
 



 ● Represent Miles credibly to senior, passive candidates who are not actively jobhunting.
 



 ● Maintain accurate requisition and pipeline data in the ATS (Zoho/equivalent).
 



 ● Ensure offer documentation and onboarding handoffs meet Miles' HR compliance standards.
 



  





 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 ● 6\-8 years in recruitment, with demonstrable lateral experience for mid\-to\-senior or leadership roles, not primarily bulk or inbound hiring.
 



 ● Has run searches with zero applicant pipeline and closed them through direct outreach.
 



 ● Credible one\-on\-one with function heads and senior leadership; not intimidated by pushing back on a bad brief.
 



 ● Comfortable reporting directly to VP\-HR with search\-level detail, not just funnel counts.
 



 ● Sharp on comp benchmarking and market realism; won't let a hiring manager's wishlist go unchallenged.
 



  





 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
 



  





 ● Prior experience in an executive search firm, RPO, or a lean in\-house TA team running senior searches
 



 independently.
 



 ● Exposure to EdTech, professional services, or fast\-scaling organizations.
 



 ● Experience operating without a large sourcing team behind them.
 



  





 WHY JOIN MILES
 



  





 This role sits outside the high\-volume Inside Sales hiring engine and reports directly to the VP\-HR, giving you direct ownership and visibility on the searches that shape Miles' leadership bench.
 



  





 Please note this is a 6 days work from office based role. We are located in Koramangala, Bangalore.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Tech)
description:
**Please do not apply unless you have prior experience working in a startup or high\-paced, high\-ownership environment.** 




  





**Role: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Tech)** 




**Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru** 




**Experience: 2–3 years** 




**Joining: Immediate joiners preferred** 




**Work Mode: Full\-time, On\-site** 




  





**About Recrivio** 




 Recrivio is a technology\-enabled talent solutions company helping startups, scale\-ups and enterprises build high\-quality teams across permanent hiring, contract staffing, C2H and offshore team building.
 



  





 We are building a high\-performance recruitment team where recruiters are expected to own outcomes, move fast and operate with a strong sense of urgency.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **built their recruitment experience in a startup / high\-growth environment** 
 .
 



 This is important.
 



 We are NOT looking for someone whose experience has primarily been in a large, highly structured corporate environment with narrowly defined recruitment responsibilities.
 



  





**You should be someone who is used to:** 



* Working with aggressive hiring targets
* Managing multiple roles simultaneously
* Operating with limited hand\-holding
* Handling changing priorities
* Working directly with founders, hiring managers and business teams
* Taking ownership from sourcing to closure
* Working under tight TATs
* Solving recruitment problems independently
* Being measured on actual hires, not just CV submissions



  





**The Role** 




 As a Tech Recruiter, you will own the recruitment lifecycle for technology roles from understanding the requirement and building the sourcing strategy to screening, interview management, offer negotiation and joining.
 



  





**You will work across roles such as:** 



* Backend / Frontend / Full Stack Engineering
* Software Engineering
* DevOps / Cloud
* Data / AI / ML
* QA / Automation
* Product \& other technology roles



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Understand technical requirements and hiring priorities deeply
* Build sourcing strategies for every requirement
* Source aggressively through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, databases and other channels
* Screen candidates for technical relevance, career trajectory, motivation, compensation and availability
* Build high\-quality candidate pipelines
* Drive candidates through the interview process
* Own candidate follow\-ups and engagement
* Manage offer negotiations and closure
* Drive offer\-to\-join conversions
* Maintain accurate recruitment funnel data
* Work closely with Account Managers / BD / Hiring Managers
* Build talent pools for recurring and difficult technology requirements
* Identify funnel bottlenecks and independently solve them



  





**Must\-Haves** 



* **2–3 years of hands\-on technology recruitment experience**
* **Mandatory: Prior experience working in a startup / high\-growth company / recruitment startup or high\-intensity staffing environment**
* Strong experience hiring technology professionals
* Strong sourcing capability across LinkedIn and Naukri
* Ability to understand technical requirements beyond keyword matching
* Strong candidate assessment and communication skills
* Proven ability to handle multiple requirements simultaneously
* Strong ownership and follow\-through
* Target\-driven mindset
* Strong candidate closing and negotiation skills
* **Immediate joiner or very short notice period preferred**



  





**We Will Value You If** 




 You can confidently say:
 



 “Give me a difficult tech requirement and a deadline. I'll figure out how to build the pipeline.”
 



 You don't wait for perfect requirements, perfect candidates or perfect processes.
 



 You figure things out.
 



 You know how to identify why a role isn't moving, change your sourcing strategy, improve conversions and push a candidate from first conversation to joining.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 



* Recruiters who only forward CVs
* People who need constant follow\-ups from their manager
* Purely coordination\-focused recruiters
* Candidates without meaningful technology hiring exposure
* Candidates coming exclusively from slow, highly structured recruitment environments
* People who measure their work by activity rather than hiring outcomes



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 




 Performance will be measured primarily on:
 


* Quality of submissions
* Interviews generated
* Offers closed
* Offer\-to\-join conversion
* Hiring TAT
* Candidate quality
* Client / hiring\-manager feedback
* Achievement of hiring targets



  





 In short
 



**2–3 years experience. Strong tech recruitment. Startup environment. High ownership. High intensity. Immediate joiner preferred.** 




  





 If you've thrived in a startup where
 **speed, targets and outcomes matter** 
 , we'd like to talk.

 If you want to build, develop, and see your impact, join Skillz and level up your Career!
   

  

 Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile eSports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide, is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi\-million dollar franchises by enabling real\-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 At Skillz, we understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. Learn more to see if Skillz is the right fit for your next career move!
   

  

**Why Skillz**
* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value, obsess over our product, and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your dependents. Additionally, take advantage of our 401K matching, pre\-tax benefit options, and more.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well\-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Time off: We offer competitive paid time off (PTO) \& company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Development Opportunities: We hold our employees to high standards while providing them with professional growth opportunities. We operate like a startup, and encourage all of our employees to collaborate and voice feedback about our product and ways we can improve as a business. We believe in never settling, and that also pertains to your growth.


**Responsibilities**
* Run end\-to\-end executive searches (calibration → market map → slate → close) with high stakeholder complexity.
* Build proactive, evergreen pipelines that reduce future time\-to\-fill.
* Improve slate quality through stronger targeting and qualification.
* Increase offer acceptance through early alignment on comp, motivations, and decision velocity.
* Reduce reliance on external search partners by creating internal “search muscle”.


**Key Competencies**
* Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of executive roles, technologies, and skills required to effectively assess candidates' qualifications.
* Strategic Thinking: Capacity to develop and execute data\-driven / strategic recruiting plans aligned with the company's growth objectives and hiring needs.
* Problem\-Solving: Aptitude for identifying challenges in the recruiting process and implementing creative solutions to overcome them, ensuring a smooth and efficient hiring process.
* Adaptability: Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities, market conditions, and business needs, while maintaining a high level of performance and professionalism.
* Negotiation Skills: Proficiency in negotiating job offers, compensation packages, and other employment terms to secure top talent while adhering to budgetary constraints.
* Relationship Building: Skill in building and nurturing relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and cross\-functional partners to facilitate successful hiring outcomes.


**Experience**
* At least 5\+ years (ideally 7\+) of technical recruiting experience with expertise: Demonstrated experience in technical recruiting, with a proven track record of success in sourcing, assessing, and hiring engineering talent, leveraging in\-depth knowledge and understanding of technical roles, technologies, and skills required in engineering positions.
* Experience in Full\-cycle Recruiting: Hands\-on experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews, booking travel, conducting reference checks, debriefing in hiring committees, negotiating offers, closing deals, and onboarding new hires, ensuring a seamless and positive candidate experience.
* Passion for gaming: Genuine enthusiasm for gaming and the gaming industry, with a deep understanding of gaming culture, trends, and technologies.
* Startup or Turnaround experience: Proven ability to thrive in a startup\-like environment, with a proactive mindset, strong initiative, and a track record of taking ownership of recruitment processes and driving results.

title: Talent Acquisition Associate
description:
**Role:** 
 Talent Acquisition Associate
 



**Start Date:** 
 October 2026
 



**Location:** 
 Onsite in HSR, Bangalore
 



  





**About KAVI** 




 Professional investors need to understand businesses before they back them — and the best way to do that is to talk to people who've actually built and run them. That's what we do. We connect investors with industry experts, then turn those conversations into a searchable library covering business models, competitive dynamics, and market trends.
 



  





 Over 100 investment firms, managing more than USD 100 billion in assets, rely on what we publish.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We know exactly who we want on this team. Until now, we've been finding them the way small companies do: late, and only when something breaks. You're here to change that.
 



  





 You'll own hiring end to end: finding the people, running the process, and closing the ones we want. You'll be the first person a candidate speaks to, and the bridge between them and the rest of the team. Along the way you'll also handle the smaller people things that come with a growing company — onboarding, paperwork, the occasional "who do I ask about this?"
 



  





 This is an entry\-level role. The process, the tools, the way we work — all of that we'll teach you. What we can't teach is judgement about people: reading a CV and knowing what it isn't saying, sensing within 5 minutes of a call whether someone is sharp or just polished, telling the difference between nervous and unprepared. That's the part you need to bring.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Run hiring from start to finish: source candidates, screen, schedule, interview, and make offers
* Be the candidate's guide through the process — clear, quick, and honest at every step
* Build and maintain a pipeline so we're never starting from zero when a role opens
* Handle onboarding and the basic HR admin that keeps a small team running smoothly



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A degree in any discipline — psychology, business, or HR is a plus, but curiosity matters more
* 0–2 years of experience; internships in recruiting, campus placement, or people\-facing roles all count
* A genuine read on people: you notice things in conversation that others miss
* Organised enough to run several searches at once without letting a candidate fall through the cracks

description:
**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT):** 




  





 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
 



  





 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Strategic Business Partnering
 



 • Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
 



 • Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
 



 • Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.

 • Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
 



 • Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
 



 • Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
 



 • Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
 



  





 3\. Performance \& Rewards
 



 • Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
 



 • Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
 



 • Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
 



 • Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
 



  





 4\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 • Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
 



 • Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
 



 • Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
 



 • Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.

 • Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
 



 • Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
 



 • Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
 



 • Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
 



  





 6\. Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
 



 • Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
 



 • Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
 



 • Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.
 



  





**Skills \& Attributes** 




  





 • Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
 



 • Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
 



 • Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
 



 • High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
 



 • Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
 



 • Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 




  





 • Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
 



 • 8–10 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 5 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
 



 • Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for two Recruiting Coordinators based in India to support our fast\-growing US Talent team. Working night shift hours to overlap with our Pacific Time\-based hiring teams, you'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless, world\-class candidate experience while helping our recruiters and hiring managers move quickly and efficiently.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ensure every candidate has a world\-class interview experience from first contact through offer
* Schedule a high volume of phone, virtual, and onsite interviews across hiring teams, executives, and candidates spanning multiple US time zones
* Coordinate travel logistics for non\-local candidates as needed
* Support day\-of interview logistics (virtual coordination, rescheduling, real\-time troubleshooting) to keep interviews running on time
* Manage candidate flow and data integrity through our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse)

* Support employer brand efforts by partnering with marketing and design on internal/external career page content
* Help organize and support virtual recruiting events, acting as a brand ambassador for Ethos

* Working knowledge of Greenhouse (ATS) and ModernLoop (or similar interview scheduling/automation tools)

* Comfortable and reliable working night shift hours on an ongoing basis
* High attention to detail in all candidate and stakeholder interactions
* Personable, professional, and able to maintain a positive attitude under shifting, high\-volume circumstances
* Strong organizational skills and a creative approach to problem\-solving
* Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable remote work setup for night\-shift operations


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

title: Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India
description:
**Overview:** 




  





 TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.
 



  





**Position: Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India** 




**Location: Bengaluru** 




**Work Type: Onsite** 




**Job Type: Full\-Time – Supports PAN India** 




**Function: Corporate Human Resources / Talent Acquisition** 




**Reporting To: Head of Human Resources / Senior Leadership** 




**Shift: 11 am to 8 pm IST.** 




  





**Job Description:** 




**Role Overview** 



* TekWissen is looking for a highly driven, creative, and business\-oriented Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India to lead corporate recruitment across the organization.
* This role is designed for a Talent Acquisition professional who goes beyond traditional recruitment.
* We are looking for someone who can build talent pipelines before positions open, understand the market before hiring begins, create innovative sourcing strategies for niche talent, and continuously improve the quality, speed, experience, and ROI of hiring.
* The ideal candidate should have demonstrated experience in building creative recruitment campaigns, Recruiterathons, Hackathons, hiring projects, talent communities, employee referral initiatives, campus/fresher programs, niche\-role sourcing strategies, and data\-driven recruitment programs.
* This individual will partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders across TekWissen's business units and will own the recruitment lifecycle from workforce planning and talent intelligence through sourcing, screening, selection, offer management, onboarding, and post\-joining hiring effectiveness.



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\.Corporate Talent Acquisition Leadership** 



* Own and drive end\-to\-end corporate recruitment for TekWissen across PAN India.
* Manage hiring across multiple functions and business areas, including:
* Staffing / Recruitment
* Talent Acquisition
* Corporate HR / HR Operations
* Learning \& Development
* Finance \& Accounts
* Information Technology
* Software / Engineering
* Networking / Infrastructure
* Data \& Analytics
* Back Office / Operations
* Call Center / Customer Support
* Business Support Functions
* Internships
* Graduate / Fresher Hiring
* Specialized and niche corporate positions
* Build scalable recruitment strategies based on business requirements, talent availability, urgency, and role complexity.



**2\.Strategic Hiring Manager Partnership** 



* Establish TA as a strategic business partner rather than a requisition\-processing function.
* Conduct structured weekly connects with hiring managers and business leaders.
* Understand current hiring requirements as well as upcoming workforce needs.
* Build forward\-looking hiring forecasts.
* Understand skill gaps, replacement requirements, growth plans, and future organizational requirements.
* Challenge and refine hiring requirements where appropriate.
* Provide market feedback on talent availability, compensation, competition, notice periods, and skill supply.
* Establish clear hiring priorities, timelines, and recruitment strategies for every business unit.
* Maintain continuous communication with stakeholders until positions are successfully closed.



  





**Hiring Manager Pulse** 



* Create a regular hiring\-manager pulse mechanism to understand:
* Quality of profiles
* Interview effectiveness
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Candidate quality
* Offer acceptance
* Candidate experience
* Communication effectiveness
* Areas requiring improvement



**3\.Recruitment Innovation \& Out\-of\-the\-Box Hiring** 



* We are specifically looking for someone who can rethink how recruitment is done.
* The TA Lead will be expected to conceptualize and execute innovative hiring initiatives such as:
* Recruiterathons
* Hiring Hackathons
* Talent Hackathons
* Recruitment Drives
* Mass Hiring Events
* Virtual Hiring Days
* Skill\-based hiring campaigns
* Niche Talent Campaigns
* Talent Communities
* Passive Candidate Engagement Programs
* Employee Referral Campaigns
* Campus Hiring Initiatives
* Fresher Talent Programs
* Alumni Talent Networks
* Competitor Talent Mapping
* Geo\-specific Talent Drives
* Social Recruiting Campaigns
* AI\-enabled sourcing initiatives
* Recruitment contests and sourcing challenges
* Specialized hiring projects for difficult\-to\-fill positions



 The candidate should continuously ask:
 


* “Is there a better, faster, smarter or more creative way to hire this talent?”



**4\. Niche \& Difficult\-to\-Fill Role Strategy** 



* Develop customized sourcing strategies for niche, specialized, confidential, or difficult\-to\-close positions.
* For every critical role, evaluate:
* Talent pool availability
* Competitor organizations
* Relevant industries
* Target companies
* Geographic talent concentration
* Compensation benchmarks
* Notice\-period trends
* Candidate movement
* Skill availability
* Talent seniority
* Hiring feasibility
* Create role\-specific talent acquisition plans rather than applying a one\-size\-fits\-all recruitment model.



**5\. Market Intelligence \& Competitor Mapping** 



* Build a strong Talent Market Intelligence capability for TekWissen.
* Regularly monitor:
* Competitor hiring trends
* Talent movement
* Emerging skill sets
* Salary trends
* Hiring hotspots
* Talent availability by location
* Competitor organizational growth
* Hiring volumes
* Attrition trends where information is available
* New technology and skill requirements
* Talent acquisition practices
* Industry hiring patterns
* Develop competitor and talent maps for strategically important roles.
* Provide leadership with actionable insights such as:
* Where is the talent?
* Who is hiring the talent?
* What are they paying?
* What skills are emerging?
* Where should TekWissen hire?
* What talent should we build pipelines for now?



**6\. Workforce \& Hiring Forecasting** 



* Develop forward\-looking recruitment forecasts in partnership with business leaders.
* Maintain visibility into:
* Current open positions
* Expected upcoming requirements
* Replacement hiring
* Growth hiring
* Seasonal hiring
* Fresher / internship requirements
* Critical skill requirements
* Anticipated hiring challenges
* Talent availability
* Recruitment capacity
* Create proactive talent pipelines for future requirements rather than waiting for requisitions to open.



**7\. Candidate Screening \& Selection** 



* Own the quality of candidates entering the interview process.
* Responsibilities include:
* Resume screening
* Candidate qualification
* Initial recruiter interviews
* Competency assessment
* Communication and behavioral assessment
* Compensation discussions
* Notice\-period validation
* Motivation and career assessment
* Role\-fit evaluation
* Candidate profiling
* Interview coordination
* Hiring\-manager feedback management
* For critical roles, provide hiring managers with structured candidate summaries and market context.



**8\. Spotlight Calls \& Candidate Engagement** 



* Develop a strong candidate engagement process throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Own or coordinate:
* Spotlight calls
* Candidate expectation setting
* Role discussions
* Career opportunity conversations
* Interview preparation
* Offer discussions
* Counter\-offer management
* Joining commitment
* Pre\-joining engagement
* Ensure candidates receive a consistent and professional TekWissen experience from first contact through joining.



**9\. Offer Management \& Closure** 



* Drive the complete offer process and maximize offer\-to\-join conversion.
* Monitor:
* Offers released
* Offer acceptance
* Offer declines
* Counter offers
* Dropouts
* Notice periods
* Joining commitments
* Joining conversions
* Identify patterns behind offer declines and develop corrective strategies.



**10\. Onboarding \& Post\-Hire Talent Analytics** 



* Recruitment success should not end when the candidate joins.
* The TA Lead will establish a 1–90 Day New Hire Success Measurement framework.
* Track and analyze:
* **Day 1–7**
* Joining experience
* Onboarding completion
* Documentation
* Initial engagement



  




* **Day 30**
* Manager feedback
* Role alignment
* Early performance indicators
* Employee experience
* Potential concerns

**Talent Acquisition \& Process Improvement**

title: Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, WWAS TA
description:
**Description**
 This is a contractual role.
   

  

 Are you passionate about connecting talented people with meaningful careers? At Amazon, our recruiting team plays a critical role in shaping the future of the company by identifying and hiring exceptional talent across a wide range of roles. As a Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, you will manage the end\-to\-end recruiting process — from sourcing and engaging candidates to preparing them for interviews and closing offers. You will partner with hiring teams to understand their needs, build strong candidate pipelines, and deliver a positive experience for every person who interacts with Amazon during the hiring process.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who is curious, resourceful, and motivated by the challenge of finding the right person for the right opportunity. You will use data\-driven sourcing strategies, creative outreach methods, and your growing knowledge of Amazon's culture to attract qualified candidates efficiently. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy building relationships with both candidates and internal partners, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Source and engage candidates using internal and external tools, Boolean search logic, and multiple sourcing channels to build high\-quality, unbiased candidate pipelines aligned with hiring team goals and service\-level expectations.
* Conduct thorough pre\-screens to assess candidate qualifications, compensation expectations, skill level, and availability, while clearly communicating the interview process and setting accurate expectations on leveling and compensation.
* Coach candidates on behavioral interviewing techniques and the overall interview process to ensure they are well\-prepared, creating a consistently positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Partner with hiring managers and recruiting team members to calibrate candidate profiles, share pipeline insights, and surface blockers or process improvement opportunities that strengthen hiring effectiveness.
* Leverage recruiting data and reporting mechanisms to track candidate funnel quality, measure sourcing project outcomes, and maintain data integrity across all recruiting systems and documentation.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will start your morning reviewing your candidate pipeline, following up with prospects, and scheduling pre\-screen calls. Throughout the day, you will connect with candidates to learn about their backgrounds, walk them through what to expect from Amazon's interview process, and help them put their best foot forward. You will also join intake meetings with hiring managers, collaborate with your recruiting team on sourcing strategies, and update candidate records to keep your data clean and actionable.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our recruiting team is dedicated to delivering an outstanding hiring experience for candidates and internal partners alike. We work collaboratively to meet hiring goals while continuously improving our processes and tools. Whether you are refining a sourcing strategy or coaching a candidate through an offer, you will be part of a supportive team that values growth, creativity, and accountability. We are focused on building an inclusive hiring culture and are excited to welcome new team members who share that commitment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience building candidate sourcing and closing strategies
* 2\+ years of technical recruiting in high volume and high hiring bar environment experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. title: PROCESS DELIVERY SPECIALIST-TALENT ACQUISITION OPTIMIZATION
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting embraces long\-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
   

  

 Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long\-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As Senior Process Analyst – Recruitment, you are responsible for working with partners and providing end\-to\-end recruitment support. You will work closely with the client IBM’s operation management, and staff. You will define, develop, plan, and implement sourcing strategies to provide a qualified talent pool.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Include**
* Take ownership of the sourcing life cycle, ensuring process adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA) as appropriate, and taking actions where necessary to drive success.
* Conduct an initial assessment of the candidate's suitability.
* Follow new methods with the approach for sourcing candidates and generating new leads.
* Work in conjunction with the business head in the establishment of weekly/quarterly/yearly Global Delivery Center goals.
* Utilize ATS to perform candidate screening (and other program tools).
* Ensure detailed screening and selection criteria to identify top talent and resolve the meaningful strength of the talent in the pool.
* Update the status of Candidates on the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) regularly.
* Perform other miscellaneous duties as required by management.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Graduate/Postgraduate with a minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in recruitment standard methodologies (preferably in ITES / BPO / FA).
* Experience in building rapport and collaborating with Hiring Managers through the open requisition, sourcing, debriefing and offer stages.
* Expertise in sourcing through social media channels and other innovative sourcing channels.
* Demonstrable experience in partner management and strength to hold difficult conversations with them.
* Build expertise in deep domain knowledge and understanding of business strategy and drive innovation.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Experience in direct sourcing and recruitment experience in a corporate or consultancy (RPO set\-up is preferred).
* Equipped with consultative instinct, passionate about recruiting and not view the role as transactional Proficiency and experience in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) will be an advantage.
* Ambitious individual who can work under their direction towards agreed targets/goals.
* Proven change management and open to it good time management and working under tight deadlines.
* Demonstrated interpersonal skills while contributing to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
* Maintain technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing publications.

title: Associate I & II- Talent Acquisition (Strategy & Business Operations)
description:
**Location: Bangalore** 




  





**About Navi** 




 At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology\-first products built at scale.
 



 Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.
 



 Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low\-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest\-growing UPI platforms.
 



  





**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.** 




  





**Why Explore a Career at Navi?** 




**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact** 




 At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.
 



**Where Careers Accelerate** 




 Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.
 



**Where Great Talent Builds Together** 




 We take pride in building high talent\-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high\-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 The Human Resources and People Strategy team at Navi manages the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and HR operations to employee engagement and development. They partner closely with business teams to design and implement strategies that attract, retain, and develop top talent, ensuring a thriving, high\-performance organisational culture.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You will drive high\-volume hiring for Collections and other SBO roles. You will be responsible for sourcing and screening candidates, managing the recruitment pipeline, coordinating interviews, driving follow\-ups and closures, and maintaining accurate hiring trackers and reports. The role requires strong communication, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work with urgency in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





  





**What We Expect From You** 




 High\-Volume Sourcing
 


* Source candidates for Collections and other SBO roles through job portals such as Naukri, Apna, and WorkIndia, as well as referrals and other sourcing channels
* Build a strong pipeline of qualified candidates to meet hiring requirement



  





 Outbound Calling \& Screening
 


* Conduct bulk outbound calls to engage prospective candidates.
* Perform initial screening and assess candidate suitability based on communication skills, role understanding, interest, and willingness to proceed



  





 Pipeline Management
 


* Maintain and manage an active candidate pipeline aligned with daily and weekly hiring targets
* Ensure continuous candidate flow for ongoing hiring need



  





 Interview Coordination
 


* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics, ensuring candidate availability and smooth communication throughout the process.



  





 Follow\-ups \& Closures
 


* Drive regular follow\-ups with candidates regarding interview attendance, feedback, offer acceptance, and joining formalities.
* Support timely closures of open positions



  





 Tracker Management
 


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment trackers covering sourcing, pipeline status, interviews, offers, and joining.
* Ensure data integrity and timely update



  





 Data Reporting
 


* Share daily and weekly recruitment reports highlighting key metrics such as sourcing volume, conversion ratios, pipeline status, and hiring progress
* Provide insights to support recruitment planning and decision\-making



  





 Process Adherence
 


* Ensure compliance with recruitment SOPs, documentation requirements, hiring guidelines, and timelines.
* Maintain process discipline and support audit readiness where applicable.



  





**Must Haves** 



* Minimum 6 months of work experience in Talent Acquisition (preferably volume hiring) and eager to pursue a career in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Adaptability: Quick learner with the ability to adjust in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Relationship Building: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster meaningful connections with candidates, hiring managers, stakeholders, and colleagues
* Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey information effectively and professionally.
* Integrity: High standards of ethics and professionalism in all interactions
* Candidate\-First Mindset: A genuine focus on delivering a positive candidate experience.



  





**The Navi OS** 




 The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.
 



  




* **Start with the customer**
* **Master the details**
* **Act with urgency**
* **Own the outcome**

**Win as one** 




 We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation. To read more about the Navi OS, visit
 **navi.com/our\-values**
 .
 



  





**Life at Navi** 




 Life at Navi is fast\-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.
 



 We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, and a workplace designed for both productivity and well\-being.
 



 Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

 **navi.com/careers/life\-at\-navi**
 .
 



  





**If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you, Navi could be the place for you.**

description:
**About TrueFoundry** 




 Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
 



**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.** 




 We're TrueFoundry, and we're building it. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist (Technical Recruiter) to join the team.
 



**The Problem We're Solving** 




 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
 



 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
 



 You need a control plane that handles:
 


* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents



**AI Gateway** 
 is the control plane, five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
 



 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a strategic and highly skilled Recruiter who excels in LinkedIn sourcing and can independently drive full\-cycle hiring. This role demands exceptional stakeholder management, strong market intelligence, and the ability to craft deep talent pipelines across technical and business functions.
 



**What are we looking for?** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across engineering, product.

* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
* Partner with hiring managers to refine role requirements and hiring strategies.
* Conduct screening calls to assess skills, motivation, and culture fit.
* Manage interview coordination, feedback loops, and candidate communication.
* Maintain accurate ATS data and share structured hiring reports.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment\-led campaigns.



**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in fast\-growing tech startups.

* Ability to manage multiple open roles with quick turnaround.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms ( Greenhouse would be preferred).
* High ownership mindset, strong prioritization, and ability to work independently.
* US Geography hiring with respect to Sales and Engineering is must have.



**Highly appreciated if you have** 



* Understanding of engineering teams, tech stacks, and AI/ML hiring needs.
* Prior experience hiring in developer tools or AI startups

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description** 




  





**The role** 




  





 You will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer. The people you'll be hiring are directors and C\-level, so you are the first impression this company makes on them. You'll run intake directly with our founders and department heads, which includes telling them when the brief they've given you will not produce the hire they want.
 



  





 This is not a coordination role. It is not suited to someone who needs the search strategy decided before they start.
 



  





**Who We Are** 




  





 AI Acquisition is a multi\-8\-figure business helping founders and operators scale with AI. T vchousands of clients, hundreds of mastermind participants, with the US as our primary market. We're bootstrapped with no outside capital, so we set our own timelines and hire people who can operate without a script.
 



  





 Our Talent function was built from zero in the last fifteen months: ATS, AI screening gates, tiered assessment frameworks, and a hiring bar the founders now use. A delivery team handles high\-volume pipeline operations. You'll take whatever needs judgement, at any level, and you'll pick up the rest when the load demands it.
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Engagement and hours** 




  





 This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and statutory obligations in your country of residence.
 



 Expect a 50 to 60 hour week. Our team spans the UAE, the UK and the US, and this role holds the middle of that span. Your day starts on UAE business hours and runs into the US East Coast morning, with senior candidate calls landing outside conventional hours.
 



 We say this plainly because the people who do well here choose it. If you need fixed hours, this is not the right role and we would rather you know before you apply.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




* The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C\-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly
* Pipeline building ahead of the requisition. Talent mapped, warmed and ready before the role opens, not scrambled when it does
* Candidate engagement over months, not days. Keeping strong people warm when there is nothing live for them, and giving them a reason to take your call the next time
* Employer brand in practice. Being able to answer "why would I leave what I have for AIA" with something specific and true, and building the narrative that makes senior people want the conversation
* Strategic advisory to hiring managers. Market reality, realistic timelines, what the role needs to pay, and when the brief they've written will not produce the hire they want
* Intake and calibration with founders and department heads, including the disagreement
* First contact with director and C\-level candidates, and being the reason they stay in process instead of going quiet
* Direct sourcing where no pipeline exists and inbound is useless
* Written candidate evaluations a founder can decide on without a follow\-up call
* Quality oversight on shortlists coming through the delivery team Testing what works. Running A/B on titles, post copy and channels, and making the call on what to keep based on quality of applicant rather than volume
* Assessment design and execution. Building and running structured evaluations, scorecards and one\-way assessments against a defined hiring bar, not judging on gut



  





**What You Need** 




  




* 6\+ years in talent acquisition, at least 3 of them in\-house, embedded or RPO. Agency\-only will not clear the bar
* Senior or leadership search experience. Volume\-only backgrounds are not a fit for this seat
* Demonstrable hiring into the US or UK market, representing an employer to candidates in that market
* Near\-native spoken and written English. You will improvise on camera with senior people, not read from notes
* Evidence of managing senior stakeholders, including disagreeing with them productively
* Direct sourcing that works, with response rates you can point to
* Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, invoicing monthly and managing your own tax position
* Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional
* Evidence of building talent pipelines ahead of demand, not only filling open roles reactively
* You have kept candidates engaged over months and converted them later. You can name one
* You can articulate an employer value proposition and adapt it by audience, rather than repeating the careers page
* Experience designing or running structured candidate assessments. Scorecards, structured interviews, work samples, psychometric or cognitive tools
* You have tested and iterated on your own job posts and can tell us what changed and what it produced
* An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar



  





**What Stands Out** 




  




* Multi\-country or multi\-entity hiring
* You've built process, not only run someone else's
* You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
* You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
* You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
* AI\-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
* You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
* You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes



  





**Benefits** 




  





**What you get** 




  





**Up to $80K/Annually** 
 , as an independent contractor, based on experience
 



  





**Direct access to founders.** 
 You will sit in calibration with the people who make the decisions. No layers between you and the call
 



  





**A real AI stack, used daily.** 
 Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own
 



  





**A seat that rewards building.** 
 The function was built from zero in fifteen months. What you build here stays and gets used. If you want to inherit a finished process and maintain it, this is the wrong seat. If you want to put your own frameworks into a company that will actually run them, this is a rare one
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Application, one\-way video, short written exercise, structured interview with our Global Head of People \& Talent, working session with a founder. You'll know where you stand at every stage.

 We are who we are because of our people. The mission of this team is to always ensure we hire better than 80% of the people currently performing in their roles.
 



  





 Recruiting is step 1 towards building and maintaining an organization. Your role is sacred. You are the gatekeeper of the culture. Shaping the public perception of what we represent. Giving people a reason to join. Making working with Pocket FM irresistible.
 



  





 Our kind of recruiting is a mix of HR and sales, with a strong shot of marketing. Recruiters must simultaneously attract the right audience, size up a candidate, and sell them on the company. Pocket FM is only as good as its talent.
 



 It is about doing certain things right every single day. Brilliance comes from doing the basics right.
 



  





**What is the breadth and depth you will have to go to aid this?** 




  





 As a recruiter, you are expected to be a strong filter and make a decision after your conversations. For this, there is a need to learn how to articulate your ‘gut feeling’ and provide a ‘yes’ or ‘no’ answer.
 



  




* Source smarter, not louder. Sourcing is a very critical aspect of your role. Scouting passive talent from the industry and using out\-of\-the\-box sources through marketing and networking would help you meet your deliverables within the deadline. Daily, you need to identify great talent from a combination of sources and get them through the door
* Driving successful referral campaigns; our people are the best sources
 *(yes, there are many different ways of driving referral programs)* 
 . Enabling the business to generate more referrals is a very critical aspect of your role
* Be a pipeline Ninja. Maintaining a constant pipeline
 *(\~3x of targets),* 
 which ensures a solid talent pool from which we can meet our hiring requirements
* Hiring priorities shift fast. Agility and business fluency are must\-haves. Lead through change
* Protect the candidate experience. How we treat candidates reflects how we operate as a business
* You must go beyond requisitions. Understanding the why behind a hire is just as critical as the how. Influence business outcomes
* Zero tolerance for mediocrity. You raise the bar. You understand the silent cost of “adequate” hires and never settle. Because you know that one wrong hire can bring down the energy, efficiency, and performance of an entire team



  





  





**What do you need to bring to the table to perform well?** 




  




* Are you a good storyteller?
* What kind of mindset do you have? Do you think you have a learning mindset?
* Be courteous, be conversational, be rigorous, and be realistic
* Being on the same page with your stakeholders is the base starting point of your success
* Predicting the success of the candidate is your success here; hope is not a strategy
* You need to be well\-versed in the products. You cannot be on the back foot in your conversations
